Job Description

Would you like to join the leading global provider of network security solutions to help strategic accounts optimizing their customer experience? At Fortinet we are looking for a Technical Account Manager to build a long-term trusted relationship by operating as primary technical advisor for key enterprise customers.
As Technical Account Manager you will develop a deep understanding about the customer business/technical needs that will be used to provide technical support solutions tailored to their needs and challenges. Your proactive guidance will help keeping the customers mission critical environments healthy by identifying potential issues before they become problems and improving the overall customer experience via best practices and technical recommendations that will optimize their return of investment.
If you are keen in helping customers achieving their strategic objectives while working on cutting edge security products, then come and join our team.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop a deep understanding about the customer business/technical needs to provide technical information, guidance and support

Become a trusted advisor by proactively guide your customers with technical recommendations and best practices

Run advanced troubleshooting on the full range of Fortinet products, reproduce customer environments on lab equipment, recommend potential new solutions

Take initiatives and ownership of customer incidents to drive for timely resolutions

Manage customer communications and expectations until the closure of each case

Participate in customer conference calls or face to face customer meetings

Produce service reports to summarize service activity and performance for key stakeholders

Report Software/Hardware related issues to R&D department and assure follow-up

Skills and Attributes Requirements:
Good understanding of data networking protocols, specifically TCP/IP, routing and switching

Hands-on experience on security products and technologies (e.g. Firewalls, IDS/IPS, DDos, VPN, Web application Firewall)

Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills

Face to face and remote customer management experience

Previous experience in a technical support position with telco or large enterprise space.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Previous experience on Fortinet products is an advantage

Educational and Experience Requirements:
Minimum of 6 years of experience in a technical support/post-sales role

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent experience

Fortinet certification NSE4, FCP, FCSS, FCX a distinct advantage

Fluency in English and Arabic essential

### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

### Why this role matters

Lucidya operates in a complex, high-stakes environment - our customers range from government entities to large enterprises, each with unique challenges, regulations, and expectations. The Solutions Consultant sits at a critical intersection between our customers’ problems and Lucidya’s ability to solve them.

This role exists to make sure prospects don’t just see our product - they truly understand how it fits into their world, their workflows, and their goals. You’ll help customers move from curiosity to confidence, translating real business problems into clear, compelling solutions using Lucidya’s platform.

If done well, your work directly impacts deal success, customer trust, and long-term adoption. You’re not just supporting sales - you’re shaping how the market understands Lucidya.

* Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Lucidya’s products and use cases, and confidently translate that knowledge into real-world customer solutions

* Lead product demonstrations, workshops, and presentations that help prospects clearly understand why Lucidya is valuable - not just how it works
* Own and execute Proof of Concepts (POCs), ensuring customers experience tangible value before making a buying decision
* Support complex sales cycles by answering detailed questions, handling RFIs and RFPs, and addressing concerns with clarity and credibility

* Ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to onboarding and Customer Success, so customers start their journey with clarity and confidence

* You’re naturally curious - you don’t settle for surface-level understanding and enjoy digging into why a customer needs something, not just what they’re asking for
* You’re a strong communicator who can confidently present to senior stakeholders and explain technical concepts in a way that feels simple and relevant
* You’re comfortable being customer-facing, whether that’s leading a demo, answering tough questions, or facilitating a solution-focused conversation
* You enjoy problem-solving and thinking in systems - when faced with a complex request, you break it down and build a clear path forward
* You’re proactive and take ownership, following through on commitments without needing constant direction
* You have 2+ years of experience in a similar or related role (Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, Sales Ops, Account Management) within a B2B SaaS environment
* You’re bilingual, able to communicate confidently with both Arabic and English-speaking customers
* You’re comfortable using tools like HubSpot, PowerPoint, and Excel, and can interpret and respond to RFPs professionally

The Director - Geotechnical will oversee all geotechnical and ground investigation activities across the Qiddiya Development which includes leading the execution of the Cliff Stabilisation Roadmap to ensure the long-term stability of the Qiddiya Tuwaiq cliff. * Ensure compliance with international standards, local regulations, and best practices in ground engineering.

ERAM Talent is seeking for an experienced **Microbiologist**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting microbiological testing on raw materials, water, production environments, and finished products to ensure compliance with food safety and quality standards. The role requires expertise in detecting microbial contamination, maintaining laboratory quality systems, and supporting production teams with microbiological investigations.

### Key Responsibilities

* Perform microbiological analysis on raw materials, processing water, environmental samples, and finished beverage or powder products.
* Detect and identify spoilage microorganisms, including yeasts, molds, bacteria, and foodborne pathogens.
* Conduct routine environmental monitoring through surface swabs, air sampling, and sanitation verification.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of cleaning and sanitation programs, including Clean-In-Place (CIP) systems.
* Isolate, identify, and quantify microbial contaminants using standard microbiological techniques.
* Investigate contamination sources and support root cause analysis for microbiological deviations.
* Maintain accurate laboratory records, microbiological reports, and Certificates of Analysis (COAs).
* Ensure compliance with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), biosafety procedures, and laboratory quality standards.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the metrics and analytics layer of a growing e-commerce platform. You will be the driving force behind how merchants understand and grow their businesses through data — ensuring every report, metric, and model delivered through the platform is accurate, unified, and built to scale.

You will work closely with the Platform Reports Product Manager, Platform Data Quality Engineers and partner with PMs across all product areas to unify our data models and establish a single, coherent analytical foundation. * Own the analytics direction of the Data Platform — define the vision, standards, and roadmap for metrics, models, and reporting delivered through the platform layer.

* 5+ years of experience in data science or analytics engineering, with at least 2 years in a senior or ownership-level role.

## Job Description

The Business Architect serves as the strategic link between business vision and enterprise execution. This role is responsible for developing, governing, and continuously enhancing the organization's business architecture to ensure alignment between strategy, capabilities, processes, products, and transformation initiatives.

Leveraging industry-leading frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF, BPMN 2.0, BAGuild, eTOM, APQC, and ABPMP, the Business Architect enables business transformation by defining current and future-state architectures, identifying capability gaps, and ensuring that enterprise investments deliver measurable business value.

## Qualifications

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Architecture Development

* Develop and maintain baseline and target-state business architectures aligned with corporate objectives and digital transformation strategies.
* Document and analyze business capabilities, value streams, business processes, information models, organizational structures, and operating models.
* Design future-state business models that enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.

Gap Analysis & Transformation Planning

* Conduct structured gap assessments between current and target business architectures.
* Identify opportunities for capability enhancement, process optimization, operating model redesign, and business transformation.
* Define recommendations and initiatives to bridge identified gaps.

Enterprise Architecture Governance

* Establish and maintain business architecture principles, standards, methodologies, and governance practices.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture frameworks, business process standards, and modeling conventions.
* Participate in architecture review boards and governance committees.

Business Process & Capability Management

* Develop and maintain enterprise capability maps, value stream maps, process architectures, and business operating models.
* Apply BPMN 2.0, eTOM, APQC, and industry best practices to drive process standardization and optimization.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across business functions.

Strategic Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement

* Partner with business leaders, product owners, project managers, and transformation teams to align initiatives with enterprise strategy.
* Promote the value of business architecture and architecture-driven decision-making across the organization.
* Facilitate workshops and strategic discussions to define business requirements and transformation priorities.

Impact Assessment & Analysis

* Conduct impact analyses related to strategic, regulatory, technological, and organizational changes.
* Assess impacts on business capabilities, operating costs, risk exposure, customer experience, and organizational effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations to support informed investment and transformation decisions.

Enterprise Demand Management

* Capture emerging business needs and translate them into architectural requirements.
* Evaluate solution feasibility, strategic alignment, and business value before investment approval.
* Support business case development and prioritization activities.

Roadmap Development & Transformation Support

* Contribute to enterprise architecture roadmaps and transformation plans.
* Define implementation sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and success metrics.
* Support change management and organizational adoption efforts.

Coaching & Organizational Maturity

* Mentor stakeholders on business architecture, business process management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Support organizational maturity initiatives aligned with BAGuild, ABPMP BPM CBOK, and industry best practices.
* Promote a culture of process excellence and architecture governance.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Business Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Strategy Consulting, Business Transformation, or Management Consulting.
* Strong understanding of Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
* Experience with Business Process Management (BPM) methodologies and BPMN 2.0.
* Knowledge of industry frameworks such as eTOM, APQC, BAGuild, and ABPMP BPM CBOK.
* Experience developing capability maps, value streams, business process architectures, and operating models.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Experience working in large-scale transformation and digital initiatives.

**Preferred Certifications**

* TOGAF Certification
* Certified Business Architect (CBA)
* ABPMP CBPP Certification
* BPMN Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Business Analysis Certifications (CBAP, PMI-PBA) are advantageous

description:
**About Company:**

S&K Aerospace LLC is a subsidiary of S&K Technologies, Inc. and was formed in 1999 with a vision to become one of the preeminent professional services firms in the country and to provide opportunity and prosperity to the people of the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes (CSKT). Since inception, the S&K Technologies, Inc. enterprise has grown into a family of twelve subsidiary companies, of which S&K Aerospace is one of the largest, that support federal and commercial customers around the world.

**About the Role:**

The Site Lead Assistant supports the Site Lead in the day-to-day administration, coordination, and operational management of the U.S. Air Force (USAF) Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Base Operations Support (BOS) contract within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.  This role serves as the principal administrative support to the Site Lead and is responsible for managing office operations, coordinating personnel actions, maintaining Government property accountability, preparing official correspondence, supporting contract administration, coordinating logistics, and ensuring compliance with company policies and contractual requirements.

This position works directly with representatives from the United States Air Force (USAF), U.S. Military Training Mission (USMTM), Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF), subcontractors, vendors, and contractor personnel to ensure efficient execution of contract requirements across multiple operating locations within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The Site Lead Assistant may perform Site Lead responsibilities during periods of absence to ensure continuity of contract operations. The successful candidate must possess excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced Government contracting environment. The position requires proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Adobe Acrobat Pro), strong technical writing skills, and the ability to prepare professional reports, memorandums, and official correspondence. The candidate must demonstrate sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate records while coordinating office operations, contract administration, personnel actions, Government property accountability, and administrative support activities. The ability to establish effective working relationships with U.S. Government personnel, host nation representatives, subcontractors, vendors, and contractor employees while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and exceptional customer service is essential.

**International Conditions of Employment:**

* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Saudi Arabian Work Visa and all required host nation employment authorizations.
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all Saudi Government immigration, medical, credential verification, and employment requirements applicable to the position.
* Must satisfy all Qualification Verification Program (QVP) requirements, or any successor credential verification process required by the Saudi Government to obtain and maintain a work visa.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance is preferred, if required by the contract.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, Logistics, Project Management, or a related field with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience; or  Associate’s degree in a related field with a minimum of seven (7) years of relevant experience; or High School Diploma (or equivalent) with ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience supporting Government contracts, office administration, logistics, or program management.
* Experience supporting U.S. Government or Department of Defense (DoD) programs is preferred.
* Experience managing office operations and administrative workflows.
* Experience with records management, document control, and executive correspondence.
* Experience preparing memorandums, official correspondence, reports, and presentations.
* Experience processing Purchase Requests (PRs), coordinating vendor quotations, and supporting procurement actions.
* Experience maintaining office inventories and accountable property records.
* Experience coordinating personnel in-processing and out-processing.
* Experience supporting official travel and Contractor Travel Requests (CTR).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple administrative actions while meeting established deadlines.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Adobe Acrobat Pro.

**A Sample of Job Responsibilities:**

* Assist the Site Lead in overseeing daily site operations to ensure compliance with company standards and client requirements.
* Prepare, review, coordinate, process, and maintain official correspondence between the United States Air Force (USAF), U.S. Military Training Mission (USMTM), Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF), Government agencies, subcontractors, and contractor personnel.
* Prepare and process Sustainment Letters, Signal Letters, memorandums, reports, official notifications, and other administrative correspondence supporting Foreign Military Sales operations.
* Coordinate the complete in-processing and out-processing of USAF, U.S. Government, contractor, and subcontractor personnel assigned to the program.
* Maintain in-processing and out-processing checklists and administrative documentation.
* Coordinate installation access requests, identification badges, security documentation, and administrative processing.
* Maintain personnel rosters, organizational charts, emergency contact information, and distribution lists.
* Coordinate onboarding and administrative orientation for newly assigned personnel.
* Track assignment of computers, printers, mobile phones, office equipment, and other accountable assets.
* Prepare property transfer documentation and maintain supporting records.
* Manage office supply inventories by forecasting requirements, maintaining stock levels, and coordinating procurement to support uninterrupted operations.
* Coordinate Purchase Requests (PRs), vendor quotations, and procurement actions for office supplies, equipment, and administrative support requirements.
* Maintain correspondence logs and ensure administrative records are complete and audit-ready.
* Address and resolve operational issues promptly to minimize disruptions and maintain service quality.

**Medical Science Liaison (MSL)**

**Location:** Saudi Arabia / GCC Region (Field-Based)

**Department:** Medical Affairs

**Job Type:** Permanent

**Reports to:** Medical Affairs Lead / Medical Director

**Join us and make a difference when it matters most!**

At Mundipharma, we are committed to improving patient outcomes through scientific excellence, innovation, and meaningful partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem. We foster a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment where employees are empowered to contribute their expertise and drive impactful healthcare solutions.

As part of our Medical Affairs team, you will play a critical role in advancing scientific knowledge, supporting evidence-based decision-making, and building trusted relationships with healthcare stakeholders across Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC region.

**Role Summary**

As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL), you serve as the field-based scientific expert within assigned therapeutic areas, building trusted peer-to-peer relationships with Key External Experts (KEEs), Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), healthcare organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.

In this role, you will independently engage in scientific exchange, communicate complex clinical and scientific information, generate actionable medical insights, support evidence-generation initiatives, and contribute to the implementation of local medical strategies. You will play a key role in identifying unmet medical needs, advancing therapeutic understanding, and supporting evidence-based healthcare decision-making.

The MSL collaborates closely with internal cross-functional partners while ensuring all activities are conducted in compliance with applicable regulations, industry codes, ethical guidelines, and company policies.

This position requires significant travel, extensive external stakeholder engagement, and participation in scientific meetings, advisory boards, congresses, and educational activities across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Scientific Expertise and Medical Leadership**

* Serve as the scientific expert for assigned therapeutic areas and products.
    
* Maintain a deep understanding of relevant disease areas, treatment landscapes, clinical evidence, and emerging scientific developments.
    
* Translate scientific and clinical insights into meaningful recommendations that support local medical strategies and objectives.
    
* Monitor scientific literature, treatment guidelines, competitor activities, and healthcare trends to maintain scientific leadership.
    
* Provide expert interpretation of clinical data and communicate complex scientific information effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
    

**External Scientific Engagement and Stakeholder Partnerships**

* Develop and maintain high-value scientific relationships with KEEs, HCPs, healthcare organizations, academic institutions, and other healthcare stakeholders through compliant scientific engagement.
    
* Conduct peer-to-peer scientific discussions that advance understanding of disease management and treatment approaches.
    
* Facilitate meaningful scientific exchange and gather actionable medical insights to support Medical Affairs planning and evidence generation priorities.
    
* Represent Mundipharma as a trusted and credible scientific partner within the healthcare community.
    
* Support advisory boards, scientific meetings, investigator discussions, and other stakeholder engagement activities.
    

**Medical Education, Evidence Generation and Scientific Advancement**

* Support the planning and delivery of scientific and medical education initiatives for external and internal stakeholders.
    
* Identify evidence gaps and contribute to evidence-generation strategies, including real-world evidence projects, investigator-initiated studies, and research collaborations.
    
* Critically evaluate scientific literature and emerging clinical evidence to support medical objectives.
    
* Support scientific publications, congress activities, data dissemination, and educational programmes.
    
* Communicate relevant medical and scientific developments to internal teams to support informed decision-making.
    

**Medical Insights and Strategy Implementation**

* Gather, analyse, and communicate field medical insights to support the development and execution of local medical plans.
    
* Identify unmet patient needs, treatment challenges, and opportunities to improve patient outcomes.
    
* Contribute scientific perspectives to lifecycle management discussions, launch preparedness activities, and future medical opportunities.
    
* Support Medical Affairs initiatives through evidence-based recommendations and stakeholder feedback.
    

**Cross-Functional Partnership and Business Support**

* Collaborate effectively with Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, Quality, and other functional teams.
    
* Provide scientific input to healthcare initiatives, customer engagement activities, and product lifecycle projects.
    
* Support cross-functional projects requiring therapeutic-area expertise and advanced scientific knowledge.
    
* Act as a trusted scientific resource for colleagues and contribute to the development of medical knowledge across the organization.
    

**Medical Governance, Compliance and Operational Excellence**

* Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, industry codes, and ethical standards.
    
* Maintain accurate documentation of medical activities, stakeholder engagements, and medical insights.
    
* Ensure timely reporting and escalation of adverse events, product complaints, and medical information requests.
    
* Support the scientific review of medical and promotional materials, where appropriate and in accordance with company procedures.
    
* Identify opportunities to improve Medical Affairs processes, stakeholder engagement models, and operational effectiveness through continuous improvement initiatives.
    

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or another relevant healthcare discipline is required.
    
* A postgraduate scientific qualification, Master's degree, PharmD, PhD, or Medical Degree is considered advantageous.
    
* Additional certifications in Medical Affairs, Clinical Research, Evidence Generation, Pharmaceutical Medicine, or related fields are desirable.
    

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years' experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
    
* Minimum of 2 years' Medical Affairs experience within Saudi Arabia or a comparable healthcare environment is required.
    
* Previous experience as a Medical Science Liaison, Medical Advisor, Clinical Research professional, or a comparable scientific role is preferred.
    
* Experience supporting product launches, scientific engagement programmes, evidence-generation initiatives, investigator-sponsored research, or strategic Medical Affairs projects is advantageous.
    
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and influence stakeholders through scientific credibility.
    
* Proven success in leading projects, resolving complex medical challenges, and collaborating across multiple functions.
    

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of assigned therapeutic areas and relevant clinical practice.
    
* Sound understanding of clinical research, evidence generation, and healthcare systems.
    
* Ability to critically evaluate, interpret, and communicate complex scientific and clinical information.

* Strong relationship-building capability with KEEs, HCPs, academic institutions, and healthcare organizations.
    
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities.
    
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
    
* Proficiency in scientific literature evaluation, digital engagement platforms, and business applications.
    
* High degree of professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration.
    
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is considered an advantage.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time field-based role combining office, virtual, and external stakeholder engagement activities across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region.

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and accountability while aligning with Medical Affairs priorities and objectives.
    
* Regular interaction with healthcare stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a dynamic and evolving healthcare environment.
    

**What We Offer in Return**

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
    
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative scientific initiatives and improved patient outcomes.

* A collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.

* The chance to work in a scientifically driven environment that values integrity, excellence, and patient-centricity.
    

**Diversity and Inclusion**

At Mundipharma, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity in all its forms. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, strengthen collaboration, and ultimately help us deliver better outcomes for patients, healthcare professionals, and communities.

description:

As proud bakers and chocolatiers and custodians of iconic global brands, we don’t compromise on the quality of ingredients in our products or on the people we hire. If that is your thing, then pladis offers global ambition, a clear Vision and roadmap for success, challenge, and unrivalled opportunities to learn and make an impact

  
Click “Apply” to get started.

**Sales Operations & Order Fulfillment**

* Support end-to-end **order fulfillment** from order entry to final delivery, ensuring alignment with customer commitments and agreed service levels.
* Monitor and improve **Order Fulfillment KPIs**, including:
    * On-Time Delivery (OTD) / OTIF
    * Order Cycle Time, Backorders and Delay Root Cause Analysis
* Coordinate closely with the Sales team to ensure accurate order processing, confirmed delivery dates, and proactive customer communication.
* Support sales planning by aligning order priorities with inventory availability and shipment schedules.

**Import & Export Operations**

* Manage and support day-to-day Import and Export activities to ensure smooth execution of shipment plans and compliance with international trade regulations.
* Communicate and coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, and customers regarding bookings, dispatched shipments, and delivery schedules.
* Manage freight forwarding and customs clearance brokers for all types of Import & Export including Finished Goods, Project Cargo (Machinery), and Spare Parts, ensuring proper documentation and customs clearance.
* Track shipment status and resolve operational issues related to delays, damages, or documentation discrepancies.

**Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between Sales, Supply Planning, Warehouse, Logistics, and Finance to ensure seamless flow of orders and shipments.
* Support alignment between demand, inventory readiness, shipment planning, and customer delivery expectations.
* Identify bottlenecks across the supply chain and support corrective actions to improve service levels and reduce lead times.

**Performance Management**

* Prepare and maintain Export operational reports covering:
    * Orders, Shipment and delivery status
    * Analyze performance trends and support continuous improvement initiatives.

**Insurance & Compliance**

* Support marine and land insurance management, including policy administration, renewals, claims coordination, and payment follow-up.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, insurance requirements, and international trade regulations.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Support**

* Support process improvement initiatives related to sales operations, order management, and logistics efficiency.
* Assist in SOP updates, system accuracy, and data quality improvements.
* Act as backup to the line manager and provide operational support to team members as needed.

**Experience :**

* **7–10 years in Supply Chain / Logistics / Sales Operations.**
* **FMCG industry experience is strongly preferred.**
* **Hands‑on Import & Export experience in Saudi Arabia, including customs, re‑export, and port operations.**
* **Strong Order Management background (order flow, allocation, shipment planning).**
* **Experience coordinating with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and distributors.**

**Technical Skills**

* **Advanced Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, reporting).**
* **Shipment tracking tools and logistics dashboards.**

**Soft Skills**

* **Strong ownership mindset and proactive follow‑up.**
* **Excellent communication with internal teams and external partners.**
* **Ability to manage pressure, delays, and escalations professionally.**
* **Strong problem‑solving and stakeholder management.**

job_title: Commissioning & Start up Lead (Steam Methane Reformer (SMR) Hydrogen plants)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and safety-conscious **Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Lead** to oversee the successful transition of our Steam Methane Reformer (SMR) hydrogen production assets from the construction phase to commercial operation. You will lead the field execution team, manage interfaces between engineering, construction, and operations, and ensure that all plant systems are safely commissioned, tested, and fully functional in accordance with project specifications and industry standards.

### Key Responsibilities

* **Leadership & Strategy:** Provide technical and operational leadership for the site commissioning team. Develop and implement the Commissioning Execution Plan, including scheduling, resource mobilization, and budget management.
* **Technical Oversight:** Lead the end-to-end commissioning of SMR units, including the reformer furnace, shift converters, PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption) purification systems, compressors, steam systems, and balance-of-plant (BOP) utilities.
* **Safety & Compliance:** Enforce rigorous safety protocols (Permit-to-Work, LOTO, HAZOP/HAZID compliance) throughout the construction, commissioning, and startup phases. Act as a safety champion on-site.
* **Pre-Commissioning & Testing:** Manage pre-commissioning activities, including mechanical completion walkdowns, piping system flushing/cleaning, leak testing, instrumentation loop checks, and control system (DCS/PLC) functional validation.
* **Startup & Stabilization:** Direct the first-time introduction of feedstocks and gases, manage the ramp-up process, and conduct performance test runs to verify that the plant meets design efficiency and production targets.
* **Documentation & Handover:** Ensure all commissioning documentation (test reports, punch lists, as-built records, handover dossiers) is accurate and complete. Facilitate the formal turnover of the facility to the Operations team.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Act as the primary liaison between project engineering, EPC contractors, vendors/OEMs, and the client/owner’s operations team to resolve technical issues and resolve punch list items efficiently.

**Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or Process Engineering.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 10+ years in the oil, gas, or chemical industry, with at least 5 years specifically in a lead capacity for the commissioning and startup of **SMR Hydrogen plants**.
* **Technical Depth:**

* Deep understanding of SMR process chemistry, thermodynamics, and high-temperature furnace operations.
* Expertise in hydrogen safety, high-pressure gas systems, and PSA unit operations.
* Proficiency in interpreting complex P&IDs, control logic, and loop diagrams.

* **Leadership Skills:** Proven track record of managing multi-disciplinary site teams and coordinating effectively with contractors and subcontractors.
* **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills to perform root cause analysis (RCA) during technical troubleshooting of complex process issues.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills to report progress to stakeholders and train operational personnel on new systems.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with other hydrogen technologies (e.g., electrolysis, carbon capture integration).
* Certification in Project Management (PMP) or relevant industry health and safety certifications.
* Experience in both greenfield and brownfield project environments.

### Working Conditions

* This is a field-based, 100% site-presence role.
* Must be willing to work at construction sites, which may include remote or international locations.
* Requires flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, or shifts during critical startup milestones.

description:
### Role purpose

Own or support the business-facing data workstream for ServiceNow GRC/IRM and SPM implementation. The role profiles source data, defines mappings and quality rules, coordinates cleansing decisions, validates transformed and loaded data, and provides auditable reconciliation evidence. Technical extraction, transformation, or loading development is performed only when explicitly assigned.

### Key responsibilities

·    Inventory source systems, files, owners, entities, fields, reference data, attachments, history, volumes, formats, and known quality issues.

·    Profile source data and quantify completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, referential integrity, duplication, and timeliness issues.

·    Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping specifications, data dictionaries, transformation rules, lookup mappings, defaulting rules, and ownership records.

·    Define clear data cleansing, standardization, de-duplication, enrichment, archival, rejection, exception, and remediation rules with business owners.

·    Coordinate mapping workshops for policy, authority document, control, risk, audit, finding, BCM, portfolio, demand, project, resource, financial, and related data as applicable.

·    Prepare validation queries, sampling approaches, control totals, reconciliation reports, exception logs, and migration sign-off evidence.

·    Validate mock loads and migration cycles; document defects and support root-cause analysis, correction, retesting, and readiness decisions.

·    Support attachment and historical-data assessment, privacy/security classification, retention requirements, and access constraints.

·    Collaborate with ServiceNow consultants, data engineers, integration teams, and business owners while maintaining clear accountability for source correction and target validation.

·    Develop the end user training material and conduct end user training sessions before or after going live.

·    Provide demonstrations, knowledge transfer, administrator guidance, and functional handover documentation.

·    Maintain mapping version control, lineage, decisions, assumptions, risks, and change impacts.

### Mandatory experience and knowledge

·    At least 5 years of data analysis, data quality, migration, master/reference data, or data-management experience, including at least 2 years supporting ServiceNow implementations.

·    Previous ServiceNow data mapping or migration experience in at least one proposal-scope domain: Policy, Compliance, Risk, Audit, BCM, SPM, Demand, Portfolio, Project, or a closely related capability.

·    Strong hands-on capability in source-to-target mapping, data profiling, cleansing-rule definition, validation, reconciliation, and exception management.

·    Proficiency in SQL and advanced spreadsheet analysis; ability to work with CSV, JSON, APIs, relational data, and large structured extracts.

·    Understanding of ServiceNow tables, reference fields, choice/lookup data, import sets, transform concepts, sys\_ids, coalesce logic, and data-load dependencies.

·    Ability to produce clear mapping specifications, data-quality reports, issue logs, and migration sign-off evidence.

### Preferred experience

·    Experience with ServiceNow import sets, transform maps, IntegrationHub, or ETL tools, while recognizing that development may sit with a separate technical team.

·    Experience with high-volume historical records, attachments, multilingual data, regulatory content, or complex reference-data mappings.

·    Knowledge of data governance, metadata, lineage, privacy, retention, and data-quality controls.

·    Experience using Power Query, Python, data-quality tools, BI tools, or reconciliation automation.

·    Arabic language proficiency (spoken and written) is strongly preferred; professional English is required.

### Academic and professional certifications

·    Required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.

·    Required: Recognized data qualification or certification appropriate to the role, such as DAMA CDMP, DCAM, Microsoft data certification, Informatica certification, or equivalent.

·    Strongly preferred: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

·    Preferred: ServiceNow implementation certification or training relevant to GRC/IRM, SPM, IntegrationHub, or platform data management.

·    Preferred: SQL, data-quality, ETL, BI, or cloud-data certification supported by practical experience.

### Core competencies

Data profiling and quality analysis

Source-to-target mapping

Cleansing and validation rule design

SQL and reconciliation

Metadata, lineage, and documentation

Cross-team issue resolution

**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders and, ultimately, deliver certainty from uncertainty. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Saudi business, we are looking for Associate Directors and Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the Kingdom. Our Associate Directors and Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to the Managing Director or often directly to the Senior Managing Director.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Managing Director / Senior Managing Director led marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 8 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank as an analyst in a debt or special situations fund.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c. 2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique.

Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organizations.

## Job Description

**Job Summary**

* Project engineer responsible for maintaining and ensuring projects management activities, including project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management over all
* Oversee the safe, certified, and orderly transfer of all plant systems from the construction phase, through commissioning, and into the final hands of the operating client

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Perform ITB contract review and scope of work identification
* Ensure technical integrity and compliance with project requirements.
* Maintain project activities to ensure delivery within schedule, cost, and quality standards.
* Prepare project plans and various gate meetings, and ensure compliance with project guidelines
* Develop project scope, deliverables, and document management system.
* Drive interface management and reporting, liaising with the Client’s Engineering, Operations and Maintenance staff as required.
* Review technical submittals from contractors and suppliers.
* Coordinate Technical Bid Evaluation process and production of the Technical Bid Evaluation Report.
* Monitor project progress, including design, procurement, construction, and commissioning
* Manage pending issues and claims related to design, procurement, construction, vendors, and clients
* Identify and report on key coordination issues and act as a liaison
* Collect and compile data from various sources to support decision-making processes
* Check and report on estimates, specification discrepancies, and changes in material or labor costs
* Review and submit functional and construction details, as well as follow-up on progress
* Identify items requiring support from clients and follow-up on progress
* Identify and report on risks associated with the project and subcontractors, and develop mitigation strategies
* Maintain deliverables and monitor progress, including interface status and schedule management
* Ensure project reporting and interface definition and management, plus liaison with Client project engineers.
* Ensure that technical integrity is fully maintained and that all deviations to project standards/procedures are formally recorded and approved.
* Support commissioning activities, such as punch clear, walk-through, and handover document preparation
* Coordinate with Client, local government entities, or any companies needed for the execution of the project at any stages.
* Prepare COB (Close-Out Binder) documentation.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (E&I, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or related field.

**Experience:**

* 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in project management or a related field
* Focused on systems completion, turnover, and operational readiness within large-scale, multi-billion-dollar EPC projects
* Experience in oil / gas / petrochemical or power plants
* Engineering & Construction Company working experience

**Knowledge or Certification:**

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple activities in projects simultaneously
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management software and Microsoft Office
* Knowledge of oil and gas industry processes and regulations.

**Technical and Behavioral Competency:**

* In-depth knowledge of project management principles and practices.
* Strong understanding of engineering design and construction activities.
* Knowledge of cost control and schedule management.
* Proficient in document management systems.
* Strong understanding of technical submittals review process.
* Thorough understanding of Technical Bid Evaluation process.
* Strong leadership and communication skills.
* Detail-oriented and organized.
* Ability to work in a team environment and manage multiple stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Ability to make decisions under pressure.

**Benefits include:**

* Accommodation
* Transportation
* Flights Tickets
* Medical Insurance

description:
### About the role

We run production multi-agent systems that handle real work for a large base of users. As those systems grow, our biggest constraint is confidence: we need to know how well the agents perform, catch regressions before they ship, and keep quality steady as we release. This role owns that.

You'll build the evaluation systems behind our agents - the judges, test harnesses, and simulators that tell us whether an agent is working and where it's failing. The goal is to let us ship agents faster because we can trust what the evaluation tells us.

Evaluation is the focus, but it won't be the boundary. Because you'll understand the agents' failure modes better than anyone there will also be opportunities to contribute to agent development itself, building and improving the agents alongside the systems that evaluate them.

### Responsibilities

* Own the evaluation stack. Design and build LLM-as-judge systems, calibrate them against human labels, and make agent quality measurable per-agent and per-failure-mode.

* Make the release gate real. Build per-PR eval harnesses and regression detection wired into CI, so quality is enforced automatically, not by manual passes.
* Build user simulators to generate test coverage and adversarial cases before real users hit them.
* Turn production signal into improvement - pipe real failures back into evaluation sets so the system compounds over time.
* Partner with product to turn "what good looks like" into concrete, measurable criteria.
* Grow into agent development - contribute to building and hardening the agents themselves, starting with the components you know most deeply from evaluating them.

**Requirements**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals. Production Python or Typescript (or similar), clean API and system design, testing, CI/CD. You write code others build on - evaluation infrastructure is real engineering.
* Hands-on LLM/agent experience. You've built with LLMs - agents, RAG, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) - and understand how they behave and break.
* A measurement mindset. You reason about metrics, calibration, and experiments; you want to quantify whether something works, not just ship it.
* Production experience. You've run LLM systems in production and dealt with reliability, latency, cost, and observability.
* 5+ years software engineering, with recent hands-on LLM/agent work.

### Nice to have

* Direct experience evaluating LLM/agent systems - offline/online eval, LLM-as-judge, systematic regression testing.
* Observability tooling (Arize, LangSmith, or similar).
* Arabic language / NLP experience.
* E-commerce or merchant-facing product experience.

Join our professional maritime command team as Master aboard our fleet. This leadership role is accountable for the safe and efficient operation of the vessel, overall command of the ship and crew, compliance with international and company regulations, and the delivery of operational and commercial objectives. The Master will report to company management and be responsible for navigation, safety, crew management, cargo operations oversight, and maintaining the vessel’s Safety Management System (SMS).
Primary Responsibilities for Master - command, safety, operational leadership

• The role of the Master is to ensure the safe and efficient management of the vessel to the satisfaction of the Owners and the Charterer and to act as the Company Representative.

• The responsibilities of the Master include, but are not limited to, the Health, Safety, Security, Cyber Security and Welfare of all personnel working on the offshore installation and the protection of the environment.

• The Master is responsible for the operation of the vessel, the gangway and all other plant and equipment within safe limits and in accordance with the terms of the contract. They are the client’s and the diving operator’s (if relevant) contact person on board in connection with any contract. They will notify the owner of the consequences of deviating from the contract requirements and at no time shall they agree to any deviation without advising the owner.

• Responsible for maintaining operational records and files on board and for ensuring that the certification is always kept up to date.

• Responsible for the implementation of the Shipboard Management System. They shall, without delay, report to the Company possible modifications that they consider necessary to ensure safety and environmental protection. They are also responsible for regularly reviewing the system with a view to identifying and recommending improvements. A record of Master’s Reviews shall be maintained on board and is part of the Management Review.

• The function of the Master is to evaluate all situations, whether normal or of an emergency nature, and to take proper actions to avoid or minimize potential damages or losses, with special regards to life.

• Ensuring that any deficiencies that affect the seaworthiness of the vessel or the safety of navigation have been advised to Class and Flag State and that Port Authorities are also informed prior to port entry.

• All decisions and actions should be based on the safety of personnel and equipment and to further the interests of the Company and the Client. The Master has the overall responsibility for the safety and integrity of the vessel and for the safety and discipline of the persons on board.

• The Master is responsible for all reporting to appropriate authorities as required by law.

• The Master is the Chairman of the Vessel Safety Committee and is normally required to organize and chair safety meetings with all representatives from all parties working and living on board. They are empowered to require co-operation from all persons on board in matters concerning health, safety and the environment, as well as in matters of hygiene and during any emergency.

• They have responsibility to create a team spirit on board and to promote the shipboard management team.

• Duties include evaluation of reported non-conformities, assessment of identified hazards, initiating corrective actions when and where required and verification of completed work and activities.

• The Master is ultimately responsible for all activities on board and has therefore the duty to monitor safety awareness, emergency preparedness, hygiene procedures and health and welfare arrangements of all on board include sub-contractor personnel as well as of persons employed or sub-contracted by the client for specified duties on board.

• Ensure IMCA guidelines are followed for Dynamic Positioning Operation, where applicable.

• The Master is overall in charge for all emergency responses.

**Job Description:**

The Senior Manager – Upper Plateau Stations is a client-facing role responsible for managing and governing the **design process** for a series of complex rail stations within a major rail mega project.

The focus of this role is **process, coordination, and interface management**, not technical design production. You will ensure that the right people, information, approvals, and governance steps are in place so that station designs progress efficiently, transparently, and in line with client expectations, programme, and quality requirements.

You will act as the primary point of contact for the client on all design process matters for the Upper Plateau Stations, coordinating internal teams and external partners, and ensuring a robust, well-documented path from early design stages through to issued-for-construction design.

## Key Responsibilities

### 1\. Client & Stakeholder Engagement (Process-Focused)

* Serve as the main client-facing representative for the **design process** of the Upper Plateau Stations scope.
* Lead regular design coordination and progress meetings, focusing on process status, decision points, approvals, and outstanding actions.
* Clarify and document client requirements, decisions, and changes, ensuring they are properly fed into the design workflow.
* Coordinate with authorities, regulators, and third parties to manage the **approval process**, submission schedules, and feedback loops.

### 2\. Design Process Management & Governance

* Define, implement, and maintain a clear **design management plan** for the Upper Plateau Stations, including workflows, gates, and approval stages.
* Establish and manage design review cycles, comment resolution processes, and formal approval steps for all station design deliverables.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary inputs (architecture, civil/structural, MEP, systems, fire & life safety, accessibility, operations) through a structured process, ensuring timely contributions.
* Manage interface processes between station design and other project elements (track, viaducts, systems, public realm, utilities), ensuring information flows and responsibilities are clear.
* Ensure that changes, variations, and design updates follow controlled change management processes and are fully documented.

### 3\. Programme & Resource Coordination

* Develop and maintain the **design process schedule**, including key milestones, review dates, submission deadlines, and approval timelines.
* Monitor progress of design teams against process milestones, flagging risks and coordinating recovery or acceleration plans where needed.
* Coordinate resource planning for design activities (not line management of designers), ensuring adequate capacity at critical review and submission stages.
* Support commercial teams by providing schedule and process information relevant to change orders, variations, and claims.

### 4\. Quality, Risk & Compliance (Process Perspective)

* Implement and oversee design process governance in accordance with project quality plans and ISO/quality management systems.
* Ensure that design deliverables follow agreed review, check, and approval steps before submission to the client or authorities.
* Maintain a risk register related to the **design process** (e.g., delayed inputs, stakeholder approvals, interface dependencies) and coordinate mitigation actions.
* Ensure that compliance checks with codes, standards, and regulatory requirements are embedded into the process and completed at the right stages.
* Promote health, safety, and sustainability considerations by ensuring that relevant reviews (e.g., safety-in-design, environmental, accessibility) are formally incorporated in the design process.

### 5\. Coordination with Technical Leads & Construction

* Work closely with discipline leads and technical managers to understand their design requirements, constraints, and review needs, translating these into process steps and timelines.
* Facilitate constructability and operational reviews by organising workshops, review panels, and structured feedback sessions at key design stages.
* Ensure that construction, operations, and maintenance teams are engaged through a defined process, and that their inputs are captured, tracked, and resolved within the design workflow.

### 6\. Documentation, Reporting & Systems

* Maintain clear documentation of design decisions, actions, and approvals, ensuring strong audit trails for the Upper Plateau Stations design process.
* Oversee use of common data environments (CDE), document control systems, and collaboration platforms to support efficient design coordination.
* Produce regular client-facing reports on design process status (milestones achieved, upcoming decisions, risks, and constraints).

## Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Professional certification in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or chartered/professional status is highly desirable.
* 15+ years of experience in project management on large infrastructure, rail, or transit projects, with a strong focus on **design process and coordination**.
* Demonstrated experience managing design workflows, approvals, and stakeholder coordination on complex, multi-station or mega-project environments.
* Experience in rail/metro station projects (including elevated or plateau stations) is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with design management frameworks, common data environments, and document control systems.
* Understanding of rail industry standards, station design requirements, and regulatory approval processes.

## Skills & Competencies

* Strong process management and organisational skills, with the ability to structure complex multi-stakeholder design activities.
* Excellent client-facing communication skills; able to present process status, risks, and options clearly and constructively.
* Proven ability to coordinate across multiple disciplines, organisations, and cultures in a fast-paced mega-project environment.
* Strong planning, scheduling, and risk management competencies, with experience using project management tools and systems.
* Ability to facilitate meetings and workshops, drive decisions, and resolve issues through structured follow-up and action tracking.
* Detail-oriented, with a focus on documentation, traceability, and compliance.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are recruiting for an exceptionally talented **Risk Manager** to join their team! The Risk Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and leading the risk management framework for complex mobility and rail programmes across the full asset lifecycle.

The role ensures that strategic, technical, operational, safety, financial, and stakeholder risks are identified, assessed, quantified, and controlled for rail and wider mobility systems, supporting delivery of safe, reliable, and financially sustainable transportation services.

  
**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Establish and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework aligned with corporate policies and standards.
* Develop risk management plans, procedures, and tools tailored to rail and multi-modal mobility assets (metro, LRT, commuter rail, BRT, on-demand services).
* Define and maintain risk taxonomies
* Embed risk management into all lifecycle stages: strategy, planning, design, procurement, construction, testing & commissioning, operations, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Lead structured risk identification workshops with engineering, operations, safety, systems integration, commercial, and digital teams.
* Identify and document risks related to:
* Rail systems (signalling, train control, telecoms, SCADA, power, rolling stock).
* Stations, depots, park-and-ride facilities, and interchanges.
* Passenger experience, demand, ridership, and revenue.
* Timetable robustness, capacity, and reliability.
* Interoperability and interfaces between modes (rail–bus–micro-mobility–parking).
* Perform qualitative risk assessments using calibrated likelihood and impact scales across safety, service performance, cost, schedule, revenue, reputation, environment, and compliance.
* Support identification of systemic risks, including dependencies between assets, contracts, and external partners.
* Develop and maintain quantitative risk models for major programmes and portfolios.
* Integrate risk outputs.
* Provide risk-adjusted forecasts and recommendations for contingency levels, asset investment decisions, and phasing strategies.
* Work with technical, operations, and commercial teams to develop mitigation strategies for critical risks, including:
* Design changes and systems architecture choices.
* Safety and reliability improvements (RAMS, human factors).
* Operational concepts (timetables, staffing, procedures, incident response).
* Contract and commercial strategies (risk allocation, performance regimes, availability-based payments).
* Digital and cyber controls (access management, resilience, redundancy).
* Track mitigation implementation and assess residual risk levels.
* Provide structured risk input to key decisions, investment cases, change requests, and governance forums.
* Own and maintain programme-level risk registers for mobility and rail assets.
* Coordinate risk registers 
* Standardise risk descriptions, owners, actions, and status across the portfolio.
* Produce concise and insightful risk reports and dashboards for:
* Executive leadership and boards.
* Government authorities, regulators, and funding bodies.
* Programme, asset, and operations management teams.
* Communicate emerging risks, key risk indicators, trends, and overall risk exposure in a clear and actionable manner.
* Work closely with Safety, Quality, and Compliance teams to align risk management with:
* Safety management systems and safety cases.
* Operational readiness and assurance frameworks.
* Regulatory and standards compliance (rail safety regulators, transport authorities).
* Support hazard identification and analysis (HAZID, HAZOP) and ensure integration with the broader risk framework.
* Contribute to incident investigations and root-cause analysis, translating findings into systemic risk controls and lessons learned.
* Identify and manage risks associated with:
* Interfaces between multiple rail lines, modes, and operators.
* Shared corridors, stations, and depots with third parties.
* Public–private partnerships, concessions, and joint ventures.
* Engage with external stakeholders (government agencies, municipalities, regulators, operators, maintainers, technology providers, communities) to understand and manage their risk perspectives and constraints.
* Support negotiation and management of risk-related contractual mechanisms, including performance regimes, liquidated damages, incentive schemes, and change processes.
* Apply asset management principles to evaluate and manage:
* Whole-life costs, condition, and performance risks for key asset classes.
* Obsolescence, technology transition, and digital transformation risks.
* Facilitate portfolio-level risk assessments across multiple lines, projects, and contracts.
* Support prioritisation of investment, renewals, and enhancements based on risk and value.
* Promote a proactive, transparent risk culture across programme and operational teams.
* Deliver training, coaching, and guidance on risk management tools and techniques to engineers, operators, and managers.
* Lead regular lessons learned and post-implementation reviews, feeding insights into future projects and operational improvements.
* Monitor industry developments, regulations, and best practices in rail and mobility risk management and update frameworks accordingly.

  
**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Rail, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil), Transportation Planning, Risk Management, or a related field.
* Preferably a Master’s degree in Transportation, Systems Engineering, Project Management, Risk Management, or similar.
* Professional certifications (e.g. PMI-RMP, IRM, CRM, CEng, or equivalent) are highly desirable.
* 10 years of experience in risk management, project controls, safety, or systems engineering within Rail, metro, LRT, or heavy rail projects, multi-modal or complex transportation systems.
* Demonstrable experience leading risk management on large rail or transportation programmes
