**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking to appoint an experienced **Senior Project Manager - Design & Interface** to support its growing team!

The Senior PM: Design & Interface is a integrated team-client-facing role for a PMC, responsible for managing and assuring the end‑to‑end design and interface coordination process across multiple disciplines and packages (civil, stations, systems, MEP, rolling stock, etc.). The role has a strong focus on engineering governance, interface management, and safety assurance, rather than operations.

Acting on behalf of the client, the position ensures that all designers, contractors, and systems integrators deliver coordinated, safe, and compliant designs and constructed works that meet employer’s requirements, statutory obligations, and project objectives for scope, time, cost, and quality.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Serve as the primary PMC focal point for design coordination and interface management across the program.
* Represent the client in high‑level design, coordination, and interface meetings with consultants, contractors, systems integrators, authorities, and third parties.
* Ensure that employer’s requirements, technical standards, and safety obligations are clearly communicated, understood, and implemented by all delivery partners.
* Provide independent, objective advice and recommendations to the client leadership on engineering, safety, interface, and program matters.
* Lead and manage the overall multi‑discipline design process (concept, preliminary, detailed, and IFC) across architectural, civil/structural, MEP, rail systems, and other disciplines.
* Review and comment on key design submissions, technical reports, drawings, models, calculations, and specifications to ensure compliance with:
    
    * Employer’s requirements and project standards
    * Applicable local regulations and authority requirements
    * Relevant international standards
    
* Chair and coordinate design review workshops, value engineering sessions, and constructability reviews, ensuring that design decisions are robust, buildable, and safe.
* Oversee requirements management and traceability, ensuring that all technical and safety requirements are properly captured, allocated, and verified.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to the project’s technical assurance and design governance processes.
* Establish and manage the project‑wide interface management framework, including processes, tools, and responsibilities.
* Identify, classify, and maintain a register of all key interfaces (civil–systems, stations–MEP, systems–rolling stock, depots, third‑party utilities, etc.).
* Chair interface coordination meetings and interface control working groups, driving resolution of interface issues and avoiding late changes.
* Review and monitor interface control documents, interface matrices, and interface agreements prepared by designers and contractors.
* Ensure that interface assumptions and decisions are documented, communicated, and implemented consistently across contracts.
* Escalate critical interface risks and conflicts to the client with options and recommendations.
* Oversee, from a PMC perspective, the integration of engineering and safety requirements throughout the design and build phases.
* Review and monitor RAMS documentation, safety cases, hazard logs, and risk assessments prepared by contractors and consultants.
* Ensure that design solutions incorporate safety by design, including construction safety, operational safety, and maintainability considerations.
* Coordinate with independent safety assessors (ISA), regulators, and third‑party reviewers, consolidating findings and actions for the client.
* Verify that all required safety approvals, certifications, and authority clearances are planned, tracked, and obtained in line with project milestones.
* Manage alignment between design deliverables and construction methodology/sequencing, ensuring early identification of constructability issues.
* Support the client in assessing and approving design changes, technical deviations, and value engineering proposals, including impact on safety, schedule, cost, and interfaces.
* Ensure consistent application of configuration management across design and construction phases, including version control and change tracking.
* Coordinate closure of design‑related non‑conformances, technical queries, and RFIs, working with designers and contractors to achieve timely solutions.
* Monitor design and interface activities against the integrated master program and key milestones; identify and manage critical path items.
* Maintain and regularly update design and interface risk registers, identifying mitigation measures and contingency plans.
* Provide clear, concise reports, dashboards, and presentations for the client, covering design progress, interface status, safety issues, and key risks.
* Support project controls teams in assessing schedule and cost impacts of design/interface issues and changes.
* Coordinate with internal client stakeholders to ensure that design outcomes meet future operational and business needs.
* Interface with local authorities, utility providers, and other third parties to support approvals, NOCs, permits, and technical agreements.
* Facilitate cross‑discipline alignment among multiple design consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure integrated, consistent solutions.
* Lead and mentor a team of design managers, interface engineers, and safety/assurance specialists within the PMC.
* Promote a culture of quality, safety, collaboration, and proactive risk management across all design and interface activities.
* Ensure robust QA/QC processes are applied to design deliverables and interface documentation.
* Capture, document, and disseminate lessons learned in design, interface management, and safety assurance across the program.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring;

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, or related discipline).
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Project Management, or related field is an advantage.
* Professional engineering registration/chartership CEng, PE) is highly desirable.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2) and/or systems engineering/safety certifications are advantageous.
* Approximately 15 years’ experience in major infrastructure, rail/transit, or complex multi‑discipline projects, with strong emphasis on design management and interface coordination.
* Significant experience in a PMC, client, or international consultancy role managing design and build contracts.
* Proven track record leading multi‑discipline design teams and managing interfaces between civil, MEP, systems, and third‑party stakeholders.
* Demonstrable experience in engineering assurance, safety by design, and RAMS safety case processes.
* Experience working on large programs with multiple contractors and packages, ideally including rail/metro or similarly complex environments.
* Strong technical understanding of multi‑discipline design processes and interfaces across civil, structural, MEP, and systems.
* Solid knowledge of systems engineering principles, interface management, and safety RAMS methodologies.
* Excellent project management, planning, and coordination skills in a complex, multi‑stakeholder environment.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management.
* Highly effective communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues to non‑technical stakeholders.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and client‑service orientation.
* Proficiency with standard project management and collaboration tools; familiarity with requirements management systems, BIM/CDE platforms, and document control systems is an advantage.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken); Arabic ideal.

Parsons are looking for an exceptionally talented **Senior Manager - Technical Integration (Metro)** to join their team!

The **Senior Manager – Technical Integration, Metro** is responsible for end‑to‑end technical integration across all systems, civil works, and interfaces on a Metro Line. The role ensures that all subsystems are fully integrated, interoperable, and compliant with safety, performance, and regulatory requirements.

The post‑holder leads the integration strategy, coordinates multi‑disciplinary engineering teams and contractors, and drives integration testing and commissioning to achieve safe, reliable, and timely entry into revenue service for a Metro Line .

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Develop and maintain the overall technical integration strategy for a Metro Line, covering design, implementation, testing, and commissioning.
    
* Define integration principles, standards, and acceptance criteria, aligned with programme objectives, national regulations, and industry best practice.
    
* Establish and chair integration forums and technical coordination meetings across all packages and disciplines.
    
* Ensure clear definition of responsibilities and interfaces between engineering, civil works, systems contractors, and external stakeholders.
    
* Apply systems engineering methodologies (requirements management, V&V, configuration control) across Metro Line subsystems.
    
* Lead the identification, definition, and management of technical interfaces:
    
    * Between line‑wide systems (signalling, telecoms, PSDs, traction power, SCADA, AFC, etc.)
        
    * Between systems and civil assets (tunnels, viaducts, stations, depots, OCC/BOCC)
        
    * Between Metro Line and other lines, transport modes, and third‑party utilities
        
* Oversee the Interface Control Document (ICD) process and ensure timely closure of interface issues and technical queries.
    
* Ensure that system architectures and designs are coherent, cyber‑secure, and support future scalability and upgrades.
    
* Coordinate multi‑disciplinary design reviews to ensure integrated, clash‑free and operable solutions.
    
* Ensure that all designs meet:
    
    * Functional and performance requirements
        
    * Safety and RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety) targets
        
    * Local and international standards/codes
        
* Work closely with Independent Safety Assessor and Independent Checker/Engineer to demonstrate integrated system safety and compliance.
    
* Drive resolution of cross‑discipline design issues, concessions, and non‑conformities.
    
* Develop and oversee the integration testing and commissioning strategy for a Metro Line , including factory, static, dynamic, and trial running phases.
    
* Define test programmes and sequences to progressively validate integration between subsystems and the complete railway.
    
* Coordinate integration tests involving multiple contractors and disciplines; ensure availability of resources, access, and test tools.
    
* Monitor test results, defect logs, and corrective actions, ensuring closure of integration issues before revenue service.
    
* Support safety case preparation and approvals for trial running and passenger operations.
    
* Ensure integration of safety and RAMS requirements across all systems and interfaces.
    
* Review and consolidate safety analyses, hazard logs, and risk assessments, ensuring appropriate allocation and mitigation of hazards at interfaces.
    
* Support preparation of the system safety case, including integration evidence and justifications.
    
* Coordinate with Operations and Maintenance teams to ensure that integrated systems support operational concepts, procedures, and maintainability.
    
* Contribute to operational readiness planning and trial operations for a Metro Line.
    
* Support the Programme Director in aligning technical integration activities with overall programme schedule and milestones.
    

* Develop and maintain integration work plans, schedules, and risk registers.
    
* Identify and manage technical integration risks, dependencies, and constraints, proposing mitigation and recovery strategies.
    
* Provide regular status reports, dashboards, and briefings on integration progress, issues, and decisions required.
    
* Support change control processes, assessing the integration impacts of design changes, variations, and scope adjustments.
    
* Act as the principal point of contact for technical integration matters with:
    
    * Design consultants
        
    * Systems and civil contractors
        
    * Supervising/PMC teams
        
    * Regulators and authorities (where relevant)
        
    * Other lines / adjacent projects and utilities
        
* Facilitate timely resolution of cross‑contractor issues and foster collaborative problem solving.
    
* Support management of contractor performance related to integration deliverables and milestones.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (e.g. Electrical, Mechanical, Systems, Rail, or related discipline).
    
* Approximately 15 years’ experience in rail/metro or comparable complex systems integration projects.
    
* Proven experience leading technical integration or systems engineering on metro/rail, airport, or major infrastructure programmes.
    
* Strong understanding of rail systems: signalling/train control, telecoms, power, SCADA, PSDs, AFC, rolling stock, and their interfaces.
    
* Demonstrated experience with systems engineering processes, RAMS, and safety case development.
    
* Experience in planning and managing integration testing and commissioning activities.
    
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills in a multi‑contractor environment.
    
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and coordinate senior stakeholders and international teams.
    
* Ability to work under pressure to meet challenging programme milestones.
    
* Experience in KSA or GCC rail/metro mega‑projects.
    
* Strong English is essential.
    

**Desirable Skills;**

* Postgraduate qualification in Systems Engineering, Rail Engineering, or related field.
    
* Formal project management qualification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2) and/or systems engineering certification
    
* Familiarity with EN railway standards (e.g. EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129) and similar international norms.
    
* Experience with requirements management and configuration tools
    
* Arabic language skills

Parsons are looking for an exceptionally talented **Manager - FLS Expert MEP Design** to join their team!

The role supports the Master Developer Unit (MDU) Fire & Life Safety (FLS) team by leading and delivering specialist fire engineering, design review and advisory services across city-wide masterplanning, infrastructure and asset development projects. The post-holder is responsible for the development and review of FLS strategies and performance-based fire engineering solutions, while providing engineering leadership and guidance to internal stakeholders, Lead Design Consultants (LDCs), third-party FLS consultants and project delivery teams across all stages of design and construction.

To be successful in the role, you will bring extensive experience in Fire & Life Safety (FLS) engineering and design gained from complex masterplans, infrastructure and high-profile asset developments, with strong expertise in both prescriptive and performance-based fire engineering design. Demonstrated capability in developing and reviewing FLS strategies, smoke management systems, evacuation and egress strategies, firefighting access and emergency response planning, fire water infrastructure and integrated fire protection systems for large-scale and technically complex developments.

You'll have a strong understanding of Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA standards, IBC, IFC, Saudi Civil Defence requirements and relevant international fire engineering standards, with the ability to assess design compliance, alternative solutions and authority requirements across all project stages.

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Lead the development and assurance of Fire & Life Safety design strategies across complex buildings, infrastructure, public realm, transport interfaces and large-scale masterplanned developments.
* Act as a senior FLS engineering authority, providing clear direction on code compliance, design adequacy, fire strategy, life safety risk and buildability.
* Review and challenge FLS design submissions, drawings, reports and calculations prepared by consultants, ensuring issues are identified early and resolved with robust engineering solutions.
* Develop and assess fire engineering solutions for complex or non-standard designs, including alternative solutions, smoke control, evacuation, compartmentation, firefighting access and firefighting provisions.
* Advise on the application of Saudi Building Code, Saudi Civil Defence requirements, NFPA standards and relevant international best practice across planning, design and construction stages.
* Coordinate with architects, MEP, infrastructure, mobility, operations and delivery teams to ensure FLS requirements are properly integrated into the design, not treated as late-stage compliance comments.
* Support authority engagement and third-party FLS reviews by preparing clear engineering positions, resolving comments and defending the design intent where required.
* Provide engineering input on fire protection systems including detection and alarm, sprinklers, suppression systems, smoke management, fire water infrastructure, hydrants, fire pumps and passive fire protection.
* Identify design risks, non-compliances and approval blockers, and provide practical mitigation measures to protect programme, safety and regulatory compliance.
* Lead FLS engineering workshops, peer reviews and design coordination sessions, ensuring decisions are properly recorded and followed through to closure.
* Support the development and improvement of FLS standards, technical guidelines, review processes and lessons learned across the programme.
* Mentor junior engineers and support the wider FLS team with engineering judgement, quality reviews and consistent decision-making.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Fire Engineering is preferred; alternatively, candidates may hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another related engineering discipline from a recognized university.
* 10+ years’ experience in Fire & Life Safety engineering and design across large-scale mixed-use, infrastructure, hospitality, entertainment, transportation or giga-project developments.
* Demonstrated experience in developing, reviewing and coordinating Fire & Life Safety strategies across all project stages including masterplanning, concept, schematic, detailed design and construction support.
* Strong engineering expertise in means of egress, smoke management, firefighting access, fire water infrastructure, fire alarm and suppression systems, and passive fire protection systems.
* Experience in performance-based fire engineering design including alternative solutions, smoke modelling, evacuation analysis and complex code compliance assessments.
* Strong understanding of Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA standards, IBC, IFC, Saudi Civil Defence requirements and relevant international fire engineering standards and best practices.
* Experience coordinating with Lead Design Consultants (LDCs), third-party FLS consultants, contractors, authorities and multidisciplinary engineering teams across planning, design and construction stages.
* Demonstrated ability to review, challenge and guide complex FLS design solutions across technically challenging or high-profile developments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience preparing technical reports, presentations and engineering assessments.
* GCC and giga-project experience is highly desirable.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring;**

* Membership of the Institution of Fire Engineers (MIFireE) or equivalent professional body
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) or equivalent professional registration
* Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS)
* NFPA Certifications
* Performance-Based Fire Engineering, CFD Modelling or Smoke Control related certifications/training
* PMP or equivalent project/design management certification is desirable for multidisciplinary coordination roles

Parsons are looking for a seasoned **Senior Project Manager: Station (MEP)** to join their team!

The Senior Project Manager: Station MEP (PMC) is a senior, client‑facing role responsible for managing the end‑to‑end design and build process of station MEP works on major rail/transit or complex infrastructure projects.

This is a non‑operational position focused on project and design management, technical assurance, and contractor oversight on behalf of the client, ensuring that all MEP systems for stations (and associated ancillary buildings) are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in full compliance with the employer’s requirements, codes, and standards.

The role requires approximately 15 years of experience in building or rail MEP (mechanical, electrical, public health, fire & life safety, ELV systems), including substantial experience in design management and construction supervision, ideally within a PMC, consulting engineer, or client organization.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Act as the primary PMC point of contact for all station MEP matters, representing the client in meetings with designers, contractors, authorities, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure that the employer’s requirements, contracts, and design briefs for station MEP systems are clearly communicated, understood, and implemented.
* Provide independent, objective advice and recommendations to the client on technical, program, commercial, and risk issues related to station MEP works.
* Manage and oversee the full MEP design lifecycle for stations: concept, schematic, detailed design, and IFC stages.
* Review and comment on design submissions, drawings, calculations, models, and specifications for HVAC, power distribution, lighting, fire protection, plumbing and drainage, vertical transportation, ELV/BMS, and life safety systems.
* Ensure design compliance with employer’s requirements, project technical standards, local codes, international standards, fire and life safety regulations, and authority requirements.
* Chair and coordinate design review meetings, value engineering and constructability workshops, and multi‑discipline coordination sessions (architecture, structure, rail systems, civil).
* Oversee requirements management and traceability, design verification and validation, and close‑out of design review comments.
* Ensure interfaces between MEP, architecture, structure, rail systems, and station operations are identified and resolved at design stage.
* Support the preparation and review of technical sections of tender documents, scopes of work, and employer’s requirements for station MEP packages.
* Review and evaluate technical proposals, clarifications, and deviations from contractors and suppliers; provide recommendations to the client for award.
* Assist in contract negotiations and post‑award technical clarifications with MEP contractors and key vendors.
* From a PMC perspective, oversee and manage construction and installation activities for station MEP systems, ensuring alignment with approved designs, specifications, and quality standards.
* Monitor contractor construction methodologies, sequencing, and resource planning for MEP works; challenge and improve where needed.
* Coordinate resolution of site technical issues and RFIs in collaboration with design consultants and contractors.
* Track and manage MEP interfaces with civil works, finishes, systems integration, and other trades to avoid clashes and rework.
* Monitor compliance with project HSE requirements during MEP construction activities, and support the client’s HSE objectives.
* Review and approve, on behalf of the client, testing and commissioning strategies, plans, procedures, and integrated test schedules for station MEP systems.
* Monitor execution of pre‑commissioning, functional performance tests, integrated systems testing, and life‑safety commissioning through reports and selective site attendance.
* Review test results, non‑conformance reports, and snag lists; ensure timely rectification and closure by contractors.
* Coordinate with operations, maintenance, and systems teams to ensure that MEP systems meet handover, operability, maintainability, and life‑cycle requirements.
* Oversee completion and quality of as‑built documentation, O&M manuals, training materials, and handover deliverables.
* Manage and track station MEP design and construction activities against the approved master schedule and key milestones.
* Identify critical path activities and dependencies affecting MEP delivery; initiate recovery plans where schedule slippage occurs.
* Monitor MEP‑related costs, variations, and potential claims; support the client in negotiation and resolution.
* Maintain and regularly update risk registers for station MEP works, identifying mitigation measures and contingency plans.
* Provide accurate, timely progress reports, dashboards, and presentations for the client’s senior management and governance committees.

**Job Description:**

The Senior Manager – Constructability is a senior, client-facing role responsible for **managing the constructability process**, rather than performing detailed technical constructability design.

You will define, govern, and oversee the end-to-end process by which constructability input is planned, coordinated, executed, documented, and closed out across all major rail packages (stations, corridors, structures, systems, and interfaces).

The focus is on **project management, governance, and coordination** – ensuring that the right technical experts are engaged at the right time, that reviews are timely and effective, and that outcomes are traceable and integrated into design and delivery.

## Key Responsibilities

### 1\. Constructability Process Strategy & Governance

* Develop and maintain the **constructability management plan** for the rail programme, including workflows, review gates, and approval stages.
* Define constructability governance structures (committees, review panels, escalation routes) and ensure alignment with overall project governance.
* Embed constructability checkpoints into design and construction programmes, in coordination with design management and planning teams.
* Set process standards for constructability reviews, including required inputs, participants, documentation, and closure criteria.

### 2\. Planning & Coordination of Constructability Activities

* Plan and sequence constructability reviews across all key rail assets (stations, viaducts, tunnels, trackwork, depots, systems) in line with design maturity.
* Ensure the appropriate technical constructability specialists, designers, construction managers, operations/maintenance, safety, and client representatives are engaged at each review.
* Oversee the scheduling, agendas, and logistics of constructability workshops and review meetings, ensuring efficient use of stakeholder time.
* Coordinate cross-package and cross-interface constructability activities, particularly where multiple contracts or delivery partners are involved.

### 3\. Action, Issue & Decision Management

* Establish and oversee systems for logging constructability comments, actions, and decisions across the programme.
* Ensure robust tracking and follow-up of actions assigned to design teams, construction teams, and other stakeholders, driving timely resolution.
* Monitor and manage a constructability issues register, ensuring high-risk or cross-cutting issues are escalated and addressed.
* Ensure decisions and trade-offs relating to constructability are documented, approved through the appropriate governance channels, and communicated to relevant parties.

### 4\. Programme, Risk & Performance Management

* Integrate constructability process milestones into the master programme in collaboration with planning teams.
* Monitor adherence to constructability timelines, identifying slippages and coordinating recovery plans or resequencing where required.
* Maintain a risk register focused on **constructability process risks** (e.g., late reviews, incomplete participation, unclosed actions) and drive mitigation measures.
* Develop and report on constructability process performance metrics (e.g., review completion rates, action closure, impact on design changes and rework).

### 5\. Stakeholder & Client Interface

* Act as the senior point of contact for client and senior stakeholders on constructability **process** matters across the rail programme.
* Lead high-level constructability coordination meetings and governance forums, presenting process status, risks, and key decisions.
* Ensure alignment between constructability process and other project processes (design reviews, safety-in-design, value engineering, change control).
* Coordinate interfaces with external stakeholders (utilities, authorities, adjacent project owners) where constructability considerations affect coordination and approvals.

### 6\. Systems, Tools & Continuous Improvement

* Oversee use of Common Data Environments (CDE), issue-tracking tools, and collaboration platforms to support constructability workflows and documentation.
* Work with BIM/digital teams to integrate models and 4D/5D tools into the constructability review process where appropriate.
* Capture lessons learned on constructability process effectiveness and drive continuous improvement of workflows, templates, and governance structures.
* Develop and maintain organisational guidance on constructability process management, including playbooks, checklists, and training materials.

## Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or related discipline.
* Professional project management qualification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or chartered/professional status is highly desirable.
* 15+ years of experience in major infrastructure or construction projects, with at least 10 years in **rail** (railway, metro, LRT, or transit).
* Significant experience in **process-focused project management** or design/construction governance roles (e.g., design management, review coordination, programme governance).
* Familiarity with rail design and construction environments (stations, track, structures, systems, operational interfaces), even if not acting as a technical constructability expert.
* Experience working within large, multi-disciplinary, multi-contract mega-project or programme environments.

## Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership in process and governance, able to design and enforce structured workflows across complex projects.
* Advanced project management skills, including scheduling, risk management, stakeholder management, and reporting.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, comfortable leading senior-level meetings and presenting to client leadership.
* High level of organisational and coordination capability, managing multiple constructability streams and interfaces.
* Strong focus on documentation, traceability, and compliance with project procedures.
* Collaborative and influential, able to secure participation and commitment from design, construction, operations, and client stakeholders.
* Proficiency with project and collaboration tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, CDE platforms, issue-tracking systems, dashboards).

description:
## **Job Description:**

**Details of the Division and Team:**

Treasury plays a key role in the holistic bank-wide management of capital and liquidity to deliver high value risk management decisions and support strategic goals of the businesses, both at a Group and legal entity level. Treasury operates across the globe with major hubs in Frankfurt, London, Singapore, and New York.

Key responsibilities for Treasury are to make sure that there is enough liquidity in the bank at any point in time, that there is capital available when needed and that funds can be raised as and when necessary, all at a reasonable cost whilst balancing the needs of business growth and regulatory demands. Treasury's role extends to business steering through the effective transfer pricing of these liquidity and capital resources to the businesses.

The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be an independent and self-motivated contributor to the regional Treasury team and the local franchise. The candidate is required to demonstrate an in-depth knowledge of Financial Markets, Treasury products, systems, and regulations. The candidate is expected to bring solid stakeholder management, people management, and leadership skills in addition to product related technical skills. The key stakeholders for the role will be country management, front office business heads and business managers, infrastructure partners, and our banking regulators. The position requires an experienced and confident individual with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and develop working relationships across the bank.

Globally, DB Treasury maintains close interaction across all regions and core functions. This role will require the candidate to build relationships and leverage contacts throughout the DB Group to be successful.

**What we will offer you:**

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

**You can expect:**

* Life Insurance
    
* Accidental Death Insurance
    
* Permanent Partial Disability Insurance
    
* Private Medical Insurance for you, your spouse and dependent children
    
* Flexible working arrangements
    
* 30 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
    
* DB contributions to Employee Workplace Savings "Gosi” plan (for Saudi nationals only)
    

**Your key responsibilities:**

Based in Riyadh, the candidate will be responsible for:

* Chairing the Asset & Liability Committee for DB Saudi Arabia, UAE and Qatar, which includes setting the agenda and ensuring that business strategy, risk appetite and regulatory requirements are adequately considered when managing capital, liquidity, and funding.
    
* Managing the structural term asset and liability profiles through the Funding Planning process
    
* Management of the regulatory cash, central funding pool for the Bank, Funds transfer pricing for assets and liabilities (o/n to term)
    
* Ensuring Treasury actively and efficiently manages excess cash and risk to maximise NII for the bank.
    
* Overseeing the management and perform back up role for local funding Pool for the Bank
    
* Local ongoing management, development, and implementation of changes in Funds Transfer Pricing and Liquidity Management methodologies
    
* Interacting with the local regulators on Treasury topics, including lobbying, as required
    
* Understanding the local regulatory environments as they relate to Treasury, ensuring the Treasury team and business are always appraised of developments and changes, together with the impacts to the local business.
    
* Assisting businesses in achieving their objectives within the Bank’s risk management framework
    
* Engaging with clients on a variety of topics and accompanying business on client meetings
    
* Undertaking various projects relating to implementing of new regulations, launching new products, exploring innovative ways of conducting ongoing businesses efficiently as well as out of the box thinking to implement new strategies for Treasury management to ensure compliance with new regulations
    

**Your skills and experience:**

* Relevant degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Mathematics (or related discipline) with 10 years or more of Treasury experience.
    
* History of experience in liquidity management, balance sheet or asset & liability management and Treasury topics (or equivalent track record) within a business or infrastructure function in a banking environment
    
* Deep understanding of local markets across interest rate and FX products.
    
* Strong understanding of banking industry and regulatory environment. (Knowledge of local financial markets is preferred).
    
* Strong understanding of key Capital and Liquidity regulations impacting banks in Saudi Arabia, UAE and experience in actively managing them on an ongoing basis.
    
* A history of taking initiative and being pro-active.
    
* Strong control mind-set
    
* Exceptional verbal and written communication and presentation skills (proficiency in MS Office - MS Excel, MS word, and MS Power Point).
    
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills and building relationships with senior business and other leaders across various functions, both within and outside the bank, including regulatory engagements
    
* Ability to influence, negotiate and constructively challenge at a variety of levels.
    
* Ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines, have the aptitude to synthesize large amounts of information and develop innovative solutions.
    
* Ability to multitask, excellent problem resolution and time management skills. Ability to meet the challenges presented by a fast paced, constantly changing work environment.
    

**How we’ll support you:**

* Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
    
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
    
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
    
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
    
* Training and development to help you excel in your career

**Title:**

Electrical technician

**ELECTRICAL TECHNICIAN**

**CELE07 - Electrician**

KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers and we all share one goal of improving the World and Beyond: responsibly, and safely. We attract a diverse workforce and the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration.

KBR is looking for Electrical Technician who can Execute activities of maintenance focused in compliance with the preventive and predictive maintenance plan and an efficient and effective development of breakdown maintenance on electrical systems, equipment and facilities within his area of influence, applying the best and safe maintenance practices.

**Responsibilities:**

* Execute day to-day electrical maintenance activities on all electrical systems plant, equipment and facilities within the designated area of responsibility.
* Ensure, complies and applied SATORP's Safety and Quality procedures, during the execution of electrical maintenance activities.
* Ensure a proper execution of work and check on the activities engaged in routine maintenance activities.
* Carryout repairing and troubleshooting activities on electrical assets are carried out in timely and quality manner that helps increase the availability and reliability of these systems.
* Receive work directions from the respective Electrical Supervisor, in relation to electrical systems maintenance orders/requests.
* Follow-up on electrical maintenance work progress and submit regular progress reports to the respective Electrical Supervisor. Keep a record of daily maintenance works against planned maintenance programs and prepare work completion reports, where applicable.
* Enforce SATORP’s policies, procedures and regulations and ensure that all safety measures and precautions are strictly considered and taken care of during conducting maintenance works.
* Perform Preventive maintenance in HV and LV switchgear and control gears including testing of electronic protection relay, power circuit breaker, bus, bar contactors, motor starters, ATS.
* Perform the readings of partial discharge capacitor in HV motor.
* Perform on line analysis of current signature of motors.
* Perform testing on all kinds of transformers
* Support the switchgear operations in electrical substation when are request to do so
* Perform other related duties as assigned by his respective Electrical Leader.
* Proactive Safety aptitude and behavior.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Electrical systems.
* Good knowledge in Electrical equipment design, installation and maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Mechanical and electro hydraulic systems
* Good knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance principles and working procedures.
* Strong knowledge of standards, procedures and regulation to develop activities taking care of Health, Safety and Environmental preservation
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Ability to perform work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Synergic and Capable of handling multiple tasks.
* Good commands oral and written English.  
    

**Qualifications:**

* High School
    
* Diploma holder in Engineering or equivalent
    
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – High School.
    
* Minimum 6 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – Diploma.
    
* Hold a valid certification issued by a recognized third-party certification body or an accredited Saudi institute, attesting to the individual’s qualifications and competency to perform the works.
    
* Strong technical understanding of maintenance management of Oil & Gas Facilities
    
* Well organized and proactive with excellent communication skills

We are seeking a highly experienced Delivery Manager to lead the successful delivery of a major airport airfield and infrastructure development area, including runways, taxiways, aprons, airfield pavements, utilities, drainage systems, and associated infrastructure works. This role requires exceptional leadership, project delivery, and stakeholder management experience gained from complex aviation and large-scale infrastructure programs.  
  
The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 20 years of experience in managing the delivery of major airport, airfield, transportation, or infrastructure projects, with proven capability in leading multidisciplinary teams, managing contractors, ensuring compliance with aviation requirements, and delivering complex projects safely, on time, and within budget.

# **What You'll Be Doing:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for the successful delivery of an assigned airport infrastructure area, including runways, taxiways, aprons, airfield systems, utilities, and supporting infrastructure.
* Develop and implement delivery strategies aligned with project objectives, contractual requirements, and client expectations.
* Lead multidisciplinary delivery teams covering engineering, construction, project controls, quality, HSE, commercial, and stakeholder management functions.
* Ensure successful execution of project activities from design development through construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Drive delivery performance and ensure achievement of key milestones and project objectives.

* Ensure airfield works comply with aviation standards, operational requirements, and approved design specifications.
* Manage construction sequencing and delivery strategies considering airport operational constraints and safety requirements.
* Coordinate integration between airfield infrastructure, utilities, buildings, systems, and operational interfaces.
* Support successful completion of airfield testing, inspections, commissioning, and operational readiness activities.
* Provide leadership and direction to contractors, consultants, and delivery partners.
* Monitor contractor performance against approved programs, quality requirements, safety standards, and contractual obligations.
* Review construction methodologies, execution plans, recovery strategies, and resource plans.
* Ensure effective resolution of technical, commercial, and construction challenges impacting delivery.
* Drive accountability across contractors and project stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
* Work closely with planning, cost control, risk, and commercial teams to monitor project performance.
* Review project schedules, progress reports, cost forecasts, and delivery dashboards.
* Identify potential delays, risks, and constraints and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support development of recovery plans and improvement initiatives where required.
* Ensure effective integration between project controls and delivery activities.
* Lead coordination between design teams, contractors, consultants, and client representatives.
* Ensure design deliverables support construction requirements and project objectives.
* Review technical challenges, design changes, and interface issues affecting delivery.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces between civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, ICT, utilities, and aviation systems.
* Support value engineering initiatives and constructability improvements.

* Manage complex interfaces between airfield works, infrastructure packages, airport operations, and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate progress meetings, executive reviews, technical workshops, and coordination sessions.
* Ensure timely resolution of stakeholder concerns and delivery constraints.
* Maintain strong relationships with aviation authorities and regulatory bodies.
* Ensure all delivered works comply with project specifications, quality standards, aviation regulations, and contractual requirements.
* Support implementation of quality assurance and quality control processes.
* Review inspection plans, testing procedures, non-conformance reports, and corrective actions.
* Promote a culture of quality excellence throughout project delivery activities.
* Ensure completion documentation and handover requirements are achieved.
* Provide leadership in maintaining the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental performance.
* Ensure all construction activities comply with airport safety requirements, HSE procedures, and operational restrictions.
* Support risk assessments, safety reviews, and constructability assessments.
* Promote safe delivery practices across contractors and project teams.
* Ensure environmental requirements and sustainability objectives are integrated into delivery activities.
* Support commercial teams in managing contractual obligations, variations, claims, and delivery risks.
* Review contractor performance and support resolution of contractual issues.
* Provide delivery input into change management and commercial decision-making processes.
* Ensure project execution remains aligned with approved budgets and contractual requirements.
* Provide regular delivery updates, performance reports, and executive-level presentations.
* Report progress, risks, opportunities, and key decisions to project leadership.
* Participate in governance meetings and strategic project reviews.
* Maintain effective project documentation and delivery records.
* Provide leadership, mentoring, and guidance to project team members.

# **What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related Engineering discipline.
* Master’s Degree in Engineering or Project Management is an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of experience in major infrastructure, airport, airfield, transportation, or EPC project delivery.
* Proven experience managing large-scale airport development programs involving runways, taxiways, pavements, utilities, and infrastructure systems.
* Extensive experience leading multidisciplinary project teams and managing contractors.
* Strong track record of delivering complex projects through design, construction, commissioning, and handover phases.
* Experience working with international clients, consultants, contractors, and government authorities.
* Strong knowledge of airport infrastructure delivery requirements and airfield construction practices.
* Excellent understanding of project delivery methodologies, construction management, and contract administration.
* Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities.
* Experience managing complex interfaces across multiple disciplines and contractors.
* Strong understanding of project controls, risk management, cost management, and schedule performance.
* Ability to manage high-pressure project environments and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

# **What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional qualification such as Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or equivalent.
* Extensive experience delivering international airport and airfield development projects.
* Knowledge of ICAO, FAA, and international aviation infrastructure standards.
* Experience working under FIDIC, EPC, design-build, or similar international contract frameworks.
* Experience managing mega projects with significant stakeholder complexity.
* Strong experience in airport operational readiness, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Experience leading integrated project delivery teams across multiple work packages.
* Knowledge of BIM, digital engineering, and modern project delivery technologies.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Senior MEP Manager (Engineer)** to oversee and coordinate the design phases of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for rail and transportation infrastructure projects, including metro stations and tunnels as part of Qiddiya’s Transportation Unit.

This client-side role focuses on ensuring compliance with project objectives, monitoring consultant performance, managing interfaces, and facilitating approvals. Candidates must have extensive experience working in the concept, design and procurement phases of the project lifecycle of a Rail oriented project along with previous experience of working in an Engineering Consultancy.

The successful candidate will act as the primary liaison between the client and the appointed engineering firm, ensuring the design is finalized for tender purposes and ready for procurement of an EPC contractor. This role requires expertise in Rail Projects MEP design review, coordination, and quality assurance, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance and stakeholder engagement.

The position also includes responsibilities for design management, option assessment, delivering solutions, resolving interfaces with adjacent projects, and obtaining approvals and non-objections from stakeholders ahead of stage gates.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Drive and lead the health, safety, wellbeing, and security culture on the project, empowering the team to operate in line with QIC policies, procedures, and TBU objectives.
* Conduct safety investigations, inspections, and audits to maintain a safe working environment.
* Provide visible and inclusive leadership with a strong emphasis on design and engineering management.
* Oversee the integrated design delivery, collaborating with discipline leads and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with project objectives.
* Manage the design process, including option assessments, delivering solutions, and resolving all interfaces with adjacent projects.
* Review, analyze, and approve consultant MEP design submittals (drawings, specifications, materials) for compliance with contract requirements, international standards, and KSA regulatory codes. The scope includes all utilities demands and connection to the Rail Assets
* Ensure MEP designs meet the unique requirements of rail infrastructure, including tunnel ventilation, fire safety systems, and platform/tunnel cooling.
* Provide technical guidance to ensure designs are optimized for constructability, maintainability, and energy efficiency.
* Ensure that the MEP design meets the Client Safety requirements and compliance with the RAMS as appropriate.
* Ensure that the MEP Design meets the allocated “Customer Experience” requirements.
* Oversee scope management, constructability reviews, and contract alignment to ensure project objectives are met.
* Manage all changes related to the delivery of the scope through the defined TBU change management process, ensuring early identification and communication of potential impacts.
* Develop and implement robust project delivery plans for the MEP, to be included in project’s specific schedule, covering all aspects of project preparation, execution, and closeout.
* Monitor and report on project progress, ensuring alignment with time, cost, HSE, quality assurance, and performance objectives.
* Act as the primary technical liaison between civil, structural, architectural, Rail Systems and specialist MEP teams to resolve coordination conflicts and interface issues efficiently.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration between the client, engineering firms, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment with project objectives.
* Manage interfaces with adjacent projects and disciplines, ensuring smooth integration of MEP systems.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including contractors, consultants, and regulatory bodies, to ensure alignment with project objectives.
* Ensure a ‘Customer-first’ approach is integrated into all aspects of project planning, decision-making, and delivery.
* Where appropriate, collaborate with local authorities, contractors, and consultants to address technical queries and obtain necessary permits and approvals.
* Where applicable facilitate non-objection certificates (NOCs) and approvals from stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and project specifications.
* Represent the client in design coordination meetings and value engineering sessions.
* Review and verify all design documentation, technical queries (RFIs), and consultant submissions related to MEP works, maintaining accurate project records.
* Prepare and deliver regular updates, reports, and presentations to stakeholders, highlighting progress, challenges, and solutions.
* Support the preparation of tender documentation for the contractor, ensuring MEP design requirements are clearly defined and aligned with project objectives.
* Provide technical input during the tender evaluation process to ensure the selection of qualified contractors.
* Collaborate with the commercial team to ensure contractual compliance and cost control are maintained.
* Implement and maintain project management processes, tools, and best practices to ensure transparency, standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct thorough reviews of design documents to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project specifications.
* Conduct QA/QC reviews of MEP schematic designs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with codes and standards such as NFPA, ASHRAE, IEEE, and KSA regulatory codes.
* Ensure safety in design principles are applied to all MEP systems.
* Conduct audits of the design at various stages and obtain approvals and non-objections from stakeholders ahead of stage gates.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and project specifications.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with MEP design and delivery, ensuring project continuity and success.
* Develop contingency plans to address potential challenges and roadblocks.
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement in MEP processes and practices.
* Motivate and inspire a high-performance culture through clear direction, continuous feedback, and recognition of exceptional performance.
* Mentor and coach team members to support their professional growth and foster collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
* Lead collaboration with cross-functional teams to facilitate information flow and coordinate project activities.
* Participate in design meetings, value engineering sessions, site inspections, and public outreach events as required.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* A Master’s degree is preferred
* Higher National Diploma in Engineering is also acceptable.
* Professional certifications such as LEED AP, PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM or Chartered Engineer (CEng) are desirable.
* Familiarity with BIM certifications (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional) is advantageous.
* Minimum of 15+ years of experience in MEP design review, coordination, and oversight for large-scale infrastructure projects, on rail, metro, or transportation systems.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, effectively controlling design, scope, schedule, budget, and resources using appropriate digital tools.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multidisciplinary teams and delivering innovative solutions
* Proficiency in MEP design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, Carrier HAP, Trane Trace, ETAP, and Dialux.
* Strong knowledge of engineering codes and standards, including NFPA 130, ASHRAE, IEEE, and KSA regulatory codes.
* Expertise in BIM processes and digital delivery tools such as BIM 360 and Navisworks.
* Proficiency in enterprise-level project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera, or Aconex.
* Strong understanding of regulatory compliance, risk management, and quality assurance processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict resolution abilities.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing business needs, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet tight deadlines.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Must be fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent technical writing skills as well as oral and written communication skills.
* Highly motivated individual with strong organizational, leadership and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive and delivery-focused, with a strong ability to align stakeholders around a common vision.
* Knowledge of relevant codes and standards pertinent to the discipline and project location.
* Thorough knowledge of discipline engineering techniques, the design of engineered systems and design calculations.
* Must be able to review and understand project documents for technical accuracy and quality to ensure adherence to project plan.
* Proficiency in design and project management tools (e.g., AutoCAD, BIM, Primavera P6).
* Knowledge of current computer applications for engineering and design including appropriate knowledge of CAD (both 2-D and 3-D) e.g., AutoCAD, MS Word and Excel for managing design reviews
* Understanding of the roles played by other departments on projects including basic construction practices and the economics involved.
* Proven track record of coordinating and delivering large scale projects.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing business needs, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet tight deadlines.
* Skilled in managing teams and delivering results in a collaborative, cross-departmental environment.
* Strong organizational and leadership skills, with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
* A professional license from a recognized licensing or registration board, e.g. Saudi Council Engineers
* Experience working in Saudi Arabia and/or the Gulf region

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior BIM/CAD Engineer** to lead BIM coordination, digital engineering management, CAD standards implementation, model development, and multidisciplinary design coordination activities for a major Airport, Infrastructure, and Airfield Development Project.

The successful candidate will support the Delivery Partner by managing BIM workflows, coordinating engineering models, ensuring compliance with project BIM requirements, and facilitating effective collaboration between multiple disciplines including Architecture, Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, ICT, Airfield Systems, AGL, Utilities, Roads, Pavements, and Airport Specialist Systems.

The Senior BIM/CAD Engineer will play a key role in ensuring accurate digital representation of airport assets including passenger terminals, runways, taxiways, cargo aprons, aircraft stands, landside facilities, utility networks, and operational infrastructure, supporting design review, construction coordination, digital delivery, and asset handover requirements.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Lead BIM coordination activities across the airport development program.
* Establish and maintain BIM workflows, standards, procedures, and coordination requirements.
* Support implementation of the Project BIM Execution Plan (BEP) and Digital Delivery Strategy.
* Provide technical guidance to BIM engineers, CAD technicians, consultants, and contractors.
* Ensure BIM deliverables align with project objectives, client requirements, and international best practices.

* Coordinate BIM models across all engineering disciplines including:
    * Civil and infrastructure.
    * Structural systems.
    * Architectural works.
    * Mechanical systems.
    * Electrical systems.
    * ICT and ELV systems.
    * Airfield infrastructure.
    * Utilities and drainage networks.
    * AGL and airport specialist systems.
* Perform model federation, clash detection, and interface coordination.
* Identify and resolve spatial conflicts between disciplines.
* Support technical teams in optimizing design solutions through BIM coordination.

* Review BIM models, CAD drawings, and digital engineering deliverables for compliance with project standards.
* Ensure models meet Level of Development (LOD), Level of Information (LOI), and project information requirements.
* Perform quality checks on model accuracy, naming conventions, coordinates, parameters, and data consistency.
* Monitor consultant and contractor BIM submissions.
* Ensure compliance with Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows and document control procedures.

* Support BIM coordination for major airport assets including:
    * Passenger terminals and concourses.
    * Cargo facilities.
    * Runways and taxiways.
    * Aircraft parking stands and aprons.
    * Airport roads and infrastructure.
    * Utility corridors.
    * Operational and maintenance facilities.
* Ensure proper integration of engineering systems within complex airport environments.
* Support digital coordination between airside and landside infrastructure.

* Manage CAD standards, templates, workflows, and drawing production requirements.
* Review engineering drawings for compliance with project CAD standards.
* Ensure consistency of drawings, layouts, references, and technical documentation.
* Support engineering teams with drafting requirements and technical visualization.
* Maintain accurate digital records of design revisions and engineering updates.

* Provide BIM support during construction, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover phases.
* Review contractor BIM submissions, shop drawings, as-built models, and digital deliverables.
* Support construction teams in resolving field coordination issues.
* Coordinate BIM-based progress monitoring and construction sequencing activities.
* Support verification of installed works against approved digital models.

* Support development and management of asset information models (AIM).
* Ensure BIM data supports operation and maintenance requirements.
* Coordinate information exchange between consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders.
* Support preparation of digital handover documentation.
* Maintain structured project information according to client requirements.

* Coordinate with the Client, airport authorities, consultants, contractors, and specialist system suppliers regarding BIM requirements.
* Participate in BIM coordination meetings, technical workshops, and design reviews.
* Provide BIM-related technical recommendations and solutions.
* Support communication between engineering disciplines through digital platforms.

* Prepare BIM coordination reports, clash detection reports, model review comments, and progress updates.
* Maintain records of BIM issues, resolutions, and coordination decisions.
* Monitor BIM performance and recommend process improvements.
* Support implementation of digital engineering innovations and best practices.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Professional BIM certification is an advantage.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in BIM coordination, CAD management, and digital engineering delivery.
* Proven experience on major airport, aviation, infrastructure, transportation, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong experience coordinating multidisciplinary BIM models for complex facilities.
* Experience supporting:
    * Airport terminals.
    * Airfield infrastructure.
    * Roads and utilities.
    * Building services systems.
    * Large-scale infrastructure programs.
* Experience working with consultants, contractors, and client teams within BIM environments.

* Strong knowledge of BIM standards, workflows, and digital engineering processes.
* Advanced proficiency in BIM and CAD platforms including:
    * Autodesk Revit.
    * Autodesk Civil 3D.
    * Navisworks Manage.
    * AutoCAD.
    * BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud or equivalent CDE platforms.
* Experience with clash detection, model federation, and BIM coordination processes.
* Knowledge of ISO 19650 BIM standards and information management principles.
* Understanding of airport infrastructure coordination and multidisciplinary engineering interfaces.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple BIM priorities within a complex airport project environment.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* BIM certifications such as Autodesk Certified Professional, BIM Manager Certification, or equivalent.
* Experience implementing BIM on international airport development projects.
* Knowledge of ISO 19650 information management standards.
* Experience with Digital Twin, GIS integration, and smart asset management solutions.
* Experience supporting BIM-based construction management and project controls.
* Experience working under FIDIC or similar international contract frameworks.
* Experience supporting Design-Build, EPC, PMC, or Delivery Partner project delivery models.
* Strong stakeholder coordination experience with airport operators, contractors, consultants, and technology providers.

نبحث عن خريج واعد يمتلك الشغف بالتعلم، وبناء العلاقات، وصناعة الأثر، ليكون جزءًا من فريق تطوير الأعمال والشراكات في دراية. ستعمل جنبًا إلى جنب مع قائد تطوير الأعمال والشراكات، وستشارك في اكتشاف الفرص، وبناء العلاقات، ودعم المشاريع التي تسهم في خدمة القطاع غير الربحي بالمملكة.

دعم جهود تطوير الأعمال من خلال البحث عن الفرص الجديدة والجهات المستهدفة

اللغات: إجادة اللغة العربية تحدثًا وكتابة.

المهارات: شغف التعلم، والقدرة على المبادرة، والعمل بروح الفريق، والاستعداد لتطوير المهارات المهنية

2. المتطلبات المفضلة

الجنسية: يفضل أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية.

الاهتمامات: الاهتمام بالعمل التنموي، وصناعة الأثر، والإسهام في المبادرات ذات القيمة المجتمعية

المعرفة: معرفة أولية بالقطاع غير الربحي أو المشاركة في العمل التطوعي أو المبادرات المجتمعية

الأنشطة: خبرة في الأنشطة الطلابية، أو الأندية الجامعية، أو قيادة المبادرات، أو تنظيم الفعاليات

المسار المهني: الرغبة في بناء مسار مهني في تطوير الأعمال والشراكات، والاستعداد للتعلم المستمر

الهدف من الوظيفة

قيادة جهود تطوير الأعمال والشراكات مع الجهات غير الربحية في المملكة، وبناء علاقات استراتيجية تسهم في توسيع أثر دراية ونموها. ستعمل على فهم احتياجات العملاء وتحويلها إلى حلول رقمية وشراكات طويلة الأمد تحقق قيمة حقيقية للمجتمع

المسؤوليات الرئيسية

قيادة جهود تطوير الأعمال واستقطاب فرص ومشاريع جديدة مع الجهات غير الربحية والجهات ذات العلاقة في المملكة.

بناء وإدارة الشراكات الاستراتيجية مع الجمعيات، والمؤسسات الأهلية، والأوقاف، والجهات الحكومية، والجهات المانحة، والشركاء الاستراتيجيين.

فهم احتياجات العملاء وتحليل تحدياتهم، والعمل مع الفرق الداخلية لتصميم حلول رقمية ومقترحات تحقق قيمة وأثرًا مستدامًا.

إدارة دورة تطوير الفرص بدءًا من بناء العلاقة والاجتماعات التعريفية، مرورًا بإعداد العروض والمقترحات، وحتى التفاوض وإبرام العقود.

متابعة مستجدات القطاع غير الربحي ، بما في ذلك المبادرات الوطنية، والأنظمة، ودورة حياة المنح، والفرص التمويلية، وتحويلها إلى فرص أعمال.

تمثيل دراية في المؤتمرات والملتقيات والفعاليات، وبناء شبكة علاقات مهنية تعزز حضور الشركة في القطاع.

تحقيق مستهدفات النمو من خلال إدارة خط فرص (Pipeline) فعال، وتعزيز رضا العملاء، والمساهمة في تنمية الإيرادات والشراكات طويلة الأمد.

متطلبات الوظيفة

1. المتطلبات الأساسية

الإيمان بقيمة التقنية في خدمة المجتمع، والاهتمام بالعمل الرسالي والقيمي، والرغبة في المساهمة في مشاريع تحقق أثرًا مستدامًا.

خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في تطوير الأعمال، أو الشراكات الاستراتيجية، أو إدارة العلاقات، ويفضل أن تكون سنتان على الأقل منها في القطاع غير الربحي أو الجهات المانحة أو القطاعات ذات العلاقة.

فهم جيد لمنظومة القطاع غير الربحي في المملكة العربية السعودية ، بما في ذلك بيئة الجمعيات، والأوقاف، والجهات المانحة، والإلمام بدورة حياة المنح والبرامج التنموية.

قدرة مثبتة على بناء العلاقات والتفاوض مع القيادات التنفيذية وصناع القرار، وتحويل الفرص إلى شراكات ومشاريع ناجحة.

إجادة اللغة العربية تحدثًا وكتابة، مع مهارات قوية في إعداد العروض التقديمية والمقترحات.

شخصية مبادرة وقيادية تمتلك حسًا تجاريًا، وشغفًا بصناعة الأثر، والقدرة على العمل باستقلالية وفي بيئة سريعة النمو.

2. المتطلبات المفضلة

يفضل أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية، أو يمتلك شبكة علاقات مهنية قوية وخبرة عملية واسعة في القطاع غير الربحي بالمملكة العربية السعودية.

امتلاك شبكة علاقات فاعلة مع الجمعيات، والمؤسسات الأهلية، والأوقاف، والجهات المانحة، أو الجهات الحكومية ذات العلاقة.

خبرة سابقة في تطوير الأعمال أو الشراكات في شركات التقنية، أو التحول الرقمي، أو البرمجيات كخدمة (SaaS)، أو الخدمات الاستشارية.

الإلمام بإجراءات المنافسات، والمنح، والمبادرات الوطنية، وآليات التمويل في القطاع غير الربحي.

خبرة في تمثيل الجهات في المؤتمرات والملتقيات وبناء الشراكات الاستراتيجية، مع القدرة على إدارة العلاقات مع كبار التنفيذيين وصناع القرار.

You will set the operational tempo, define the standards, and hold the line on execution.

We are looking for someone who approaches operations with the same precision, discipline, and conviction that defines world-class execution. You are the kind of person who knows exactly what is happening in your domain at any given moment — not because you micromanage, but because you build systems and teams that give you full visibility and control. You take ownership completely, act decisively, and drive results without needing to be pushed.

#### **Build and Scale Operations**

* Design, launch, and scale operational processes for the electronics vertical from the ground up or take existing operations to a significantly higher level of performance.
    
* Establish standard operating procedures, performance benchmarks, and quality frameworks that can sustain rapid growth.
    
* Oversee the full operational lifecycle — inventory management, warehousing, quality inspection, dispatch, and last-mile delivery.
    
* **Drive Performance Through Data**
    
* Own the analytics layer of operations: define the KPIs that matter, build dashboards, and use data daily to diagnose problems and make decisions.
    
* Apply quantitative thinking to identify bottlenecks, forecast demand, optimise capacity, and allocate resources effectively.
    
* Build a culture where decisions are evidence-based and gut feelings are validated with numbers.
    

#### **Lead with Technology and AI**

* Actively identify and integrate AI tools and automation into operational workflows to increase speed, accuracy, and team output.
    
* Stay at the frontier of how technology is changing operations and bring that knowledge into Soum before it becomes standard practice.
    
* Champion the use of modern tooling across your team — from warehouse management systems to AI-assisted process design.
    

#### **Project Management and Execution**

* Manage multiple operational projects simultaneously with complete discipline — clear plans, defined milestones, tracked progress, and zero tolerance for ambiguity.
    
* Anticipate risks before they become problems and have contingency plans ready.
    
* Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, Tech, Commercial, and Customer Experience teams to deliver on shared goals.
    

#### **Team Leadership**

* Build, develop, and lead an operations team — setting high standards, providing clear direction, and holding people accountable.
    
* Create an environment where the team understands exactly what is expected, has the tools to deliver, and is developed continuously.
    

### What We Are Looking For

#### **Experience and Background**

* 4–5+ years of progressive operations experience, ideally in e-commerce, last-mile delivery, logistics, or a related high-throughput environment.
    
* Demonstrated track record of building large-scale operations from scratch or scaling them significantly — not just maintaining them.
    
* Fluency in Arabic is mandatory. Strong English is required for cross-functional and technical work.
    
* Familiarity with the Saudi market and its operational dynamics is strongly preferred.
    

#### **Analytical and Technical Skills**

* Deeply quantitative — you are comfortable with data, use it to guide every major decision, and can build or interpret analytical models.
    
* Genuinely excited about AI — you follow developments in the space, experiment with new tools proactively, and find ways to apply them to operational challenges.

Sitting within the PUA function, the role provides leadership, governance, and integration of all rail systems activities across multiple projects and contracts.

The role oversees signalling and train control, telecoms, SCADASCADA, platform systems, automatic fare collection, security and other line‑wide systems, ensuring that all solutions are safe, compliant, interoperable, and aligned with program objectives.

* Act as the program‑level lead for rail systems within PUA, setting direction and priorities for rail systems across all relevant projects.
* Develop and maintain rail systems strategies, standards, and technical principles aligned with the client’s vision, regulatory requirements, and interoperability objectives.
* Ensure employer’s requirements for rail systems are clear, consistent, and properly reflected in contracts, scopes of work, and design briefs.
* Provide independent, strategic advice to senior client leadership on rail systems issues, risks, opportunities, and long‑term implications.
* Oversee rail systems scope across multiple projects and packages (signalling, telecoms, SCADASCADA, platform systems, AFC, security, control centres, line‑wide systems).
* Coordinate and align project‑level rail systems managers and engineers to ensure consistent technical approaches, assumptions, and interfaces.
* Review and challenge project plans for rail systems design, procurement, installation, testing, and commissioning to ensure realism and alignment with program milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross‑project rail systems issues and conflicts, escalating to PUA and program leadership as required.
* Oversee the rail systems technical assurance framework at program level, ensuring adherence to:
    * Employer’s requirements and performance specifications
    * Local regulatory and authority requirements
    * International and industry
* Provide senior review and approval (on behalf of the client) of key rail systems design concepts, architectures, and key technical decisions.
* Ensure that requirements management, verification, and validation processes for rail systems are properly applied and evidenced.
* Support and, where necessary, chair high‑level technical and design review boards for critical rail systems decisions.
* Provide program‑level oversight of systems integration across:
    * Signalling/train control and rolling stock
    * Rail systems and civil/MEP/architectural works (rooms, routes, environmental conditions)
    * Central control centres and operational systems
    * External systems (utilities, communications providers, legacy or adjacent rail networks)

* Drive resolution of major interface issues that cross project boundaries, ensuring integrated, end‑to‑end solutions that support operational concepts.
* Provide leadership on rail systems safety and RAMS at program level, in coordination with Engineering & Safety and PUA governance.
