**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Traffic Signal Systems Expert** to join our team! In this role, you will provide senior technical leadership for the assessment, planning, design, optimization, integration, operation, and performance monitoring of advanced traffic signal systems supporting a major urban traffic management program. You will lead the technical evaluation of existing signal infrastructure, adaptive control strategies, controller configurations, detection systems, communications, priority and preemption functions, and central system interfaces, with a clear focus on measurable network performance.

You will be the central technical authority for traffic signal systems across the program — ensuring that signal operations are safe, coordinated, data-driven, and operationally realistic. You will work closely with traffic engineering, ITS, Traffic Control Center (TCC) operations, field maintenance, system vendors, and agency stakeholders to align traffic signal systems around a consistent, standards-based, and performance-driven operating model.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead technical assessments of existing traffic signal systems, including controller hardware, cabinet configurations, detection systems, communications, central-system interfaces, timing databases, and operational procedures.
* Provide expert direction on adaptive signal control strategies, including system configuration, operating parameters, corridor progression, congestion response, queue management, and performance monitoring.
* Review and optimize traffic signal timing plans, phasing sequences, cycle lengths, offsets, splits, clearance intervals, pedestrian timings, transit priority logic, and emergency vehicle preemption settings.
* Evaluate the performance of multiple signal control platforms and advise on the practical application, limitations, integration needs, and operational readiness of each platform within the agency environment.
* Lead the development of technical standards, guidelines, procedures, and checklists for traffic signal design, controller programming, detection placement, adaptive operations, signal maintenance, and field commissioning.
* Review traffic signal design packages, controller specifications, system architecture documents, testing plans, contractor submittals, and as-built documentation for technical completeness and operational suitability.
* Diagnose recurring signal operations issues, including split failures, detector failures, ineffective coordination, unnecessary recalls, poor progression, excessive queues, and inconsistent controller settings across corridors or districts.
* Define requirements for Automated Traffic Signal Performance Measures (ATSPM), high-resolution controller data, dashboards, alerts, and reporting tools that support continuous signal operations improvement.
* Work with ITS and systems integration teams to confirm that traffic signal systems properly interface with ATMS platforms, detection systems, CCTV/video analytics, AVL systems, traveler information tools, and incident response workflows.
* Support the implementation and tuning of public transport signal priority, Bus Rapid Transit signal operations, freight corridor coordination, pedestrian priority, and emergency vehicle preemption in a way that balances priority movements with overall network performance.
* Establish practical field testing, commissioning, verification, and acceptance procedures for new or modified signal installations, adaptive control deployments, detection upgrades, and central-system integrations.
* Lead technical workshops with agency staff, vendors, contractors, designers, operators, and maintenance teams to resolve signal system issues, confirm standards, and build consistent operating practices.
* Mentor client staff and project team members on traffic signal operations, adaptive signal concepts, controller logic, troubleshooting methods, performance analytics, and day-to-day TCC use of signal management tools.
* Provide input to project plans, risk registers, implementation schedules, quality reviews, and performance frameworks to ensure traffic signal system activities are properly planned, tracked, and delivered.
* Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and final reports by summarizing signal system progress, operational findings, risks, decisions, performance results, and recommended next actions.
* Act as a visible champion for proactive signal operations, helping shift the agency from reactive maintenance toward active, KPI-based management of the traffic signal network.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 15+ years of specialized, progressive experience in traffic signal systems planning, design, implementation, operations, optimization, and performance management for transportation agencies or major transport owners/operators.
* Advanced knowledge of adaptive signal systems, including adaptive control principles, detector dependency, progression logic, queue management, real-time response, system calibration, and performance evaluation.
* Demonstrated experience working with multiple signal control platforms, central traffic signal systems, controller environments, and field device ecosystems, with the ability to compare platform strengths, limitations, and integration requirements.
* Strong hands-on experience with signal timing and operations, including actuated control, coordinated control, time-of-day plans, traffic-responsive plans, pedestrian timing, phase sequencing, recalls, detector assignments, and controller parameter settings.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve traffic signal operational problems using field observations, controller logs, detector data, traffic counts, travel time data, video review, ATSPM dashboards, and before/after performance measures.
* Strong understanding of traffic signal controllers, cabinets, detection technologies, communications networks, central systems, firmware/configuration issues, fail-safe behavior, and field troubleshooting practices.
* Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing traffic signal standards, controller specifications, signal design criteria, programming guidelines, testing procedures, and operational SOPs.
* Working knowledge of ITS and ATMS integration principles, including interfaces between traffic signal systems and central platforms, detection systems, CCTV/video analytics, AVL/public transport systems, traveler information systems, and incident management tools.
* Experience supporting public transport signal priority, emergency vehicle preemption, pedestrian detection and timing, freight corridor signal coordination, and major event or construction traffic signal operations.
* Ability to lead technical reviews of contractor/vendor submissions, design packages, test plans, commissioning records, and operational readiness documentation.

The Pavement Lead Engineer will provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring pavement systems are designed and constructed in accordance with airport operational requirements, ICAO and FAA standards, project specifications, and international best practices. * Provide technical leadership and guidance to pavement engineers, designers, consultants, and contractors.
* Establish pavement engineering priorities, technical review processes, and quality requirements.
* Ensure pavement engineering deliverables align with project objectives, contractual requirements, and operational needs.

* Lead the review and assessment of pavement designs for runways, taxiways, aprons, aircraft stands, and airport service roads.
* Review pavement design calculations, technical reports, material specifications, drawings, and engineering submissions.
* Evaluate flexible, rigid, and composite pavement solutions considering aircraft loading, operational requirements, and lifecycle performance.
* Review pavement thickness design, structural capacity, durability, and maintenance considerations.
* Ensure compliance with ICAO Annex 14, FAA Advisory Circulars, and applicable international pavement standards.

* Review pavement material specifications including asphalt mixtures, concrete pavement, aggregates, subgrade improvement, and stabilization techniques.
* Assess laboratory test results, material approvals, and quality control documentation.
* Review pavement performance requirements considering aircraft movements, environmental conditions, and operational demands.
* Support development of sustainable pavement solutions and optimization of material usage.
* Coordinate pavement engineering requirements for:
    * Runways and runway shoulders.
    * Taxiways and rapid exit taxiways.
    * Cargo aprons and aircraft parking stands.
    * Maintenance areas and airfield operational facilities.

* Ensure pavement interfaces are properly coordinated with airfield lighting, drainage systems, utilities, and aircraft operational requirements.
* Support phased construction planning to maintain airport operational continuity.
* Provide pavement engineering support during construction, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.

* Review contractor submissions including shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, and technical queries.
* Monitor pavement construction activities including earthworks, subgrade preparation, asphalt works, concrete paving, and testing activities.
* Conduct site inspections to verify compliance with approved designs, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Support resolution of pavement-related technical issues during construction.

* Ensure pavement works comply with project specifications, quality standards, and airport operational requirements.
* Review pavement testing results including compaction, density, concrete strength, asphalt performance, and material testing.
* Participate in quality audits, inspections, and technical reviews.
* Monitor contractor compliance with approved construction procedures and quality control plans.
* Support implementation of corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Coordinate with the Client, airport authorities, consultants, contractors, designers, and regulatory agencies regarding pavement engineering matters.
* Support technical approvals, design reviews, and authority submissions.
* Participate in pavement workshops, technical meetings, and coordination sessions.
* Provide technical advice to support timely decision-making.

* Prepare and review pavement engineering reports, technical assessments, design review comments, and recommendations.
* Maintain records of pavement design approvals, technical decisions, testing results, and construction observations.
* Provide regular updates to Project Management regarding pavement progress, risks, and technical challenges.
* Support preparation of asset handover documentation and pavement maintenance records.

* Promote a strong safety culture throughout pavement engineering activities.
* Ensure pavement designs and construction activities incorporate Safety-in-Design principles.
* Support compliance with airport HSE requirements, environmental regulations, and sustainability objectives.
* Participate in risk assessments, constructability reviews, and operational safety evaluations.

* Bachelor's Degree in **Civil Engineering** or related Engineering discipline.
* Master's Degree in Pavement Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering is an advantage.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in pavement engineering design, review, and construction supervision.
* Proven experience on major airport, airfield, transportation, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Extensive experience with airport pavement systems including runways, taxiways, aprons, aircraft stands, and associated infrastructure.
* Experience in pavement design evaluation, construction monitoring, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, contractors, consultants, and airport stakeholders.

* Strong knowledge of airport pavement design principles and construction methodologies.
* Detailed understanding of flexible, rigid, and composite pavement systems.
* Knowledge of aircraft loading analysis, pavement classification systems, and pavement performance evaluation.
* Familiarity with pavement design software such as FAARFIELD, COMFAA, Pavement ME Design, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ICAO Annex 14, FAA AC 150/5320 series, ACI, ASTM, and international pavement standards.
* Experience with BIM coordination and digital engineering processes.
* Strong analytical, technical review, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities within a complex airport project environment.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent professional registration.
* International airport pavement design and delivery experience.
* Experience with major airport expansion, greenfield airport development, or airfield rehabilitation projects.
* Knowledge of aircraft pavement evaluation methods and pavement management systems.
* Experience working under FIDIC or similar international contract frameworks.
* Experience supporting Design-Build, EPC, PMC, or Delivery Partner project delivery models.
* Familiarity with sustainable pavement solutions, recycled materials, and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and airport authority coordination experience.

**Job Description:**

# **Role Purpose**

The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading the organization's procurement function during construction and operational phases by developing and implementing procurement strategies that ensure the timely, cost-effective, and sustainable acquisition of goods, materials, equipment, and services.

The role is accountable for strategic sourcing, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation, procurement governance, cost optimization, and continuous process improvement while ensuring compliance with company policies, quality standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Additionally, during the construction phase, the role also ensures the timely procurement and delivery of materials, equipment, and subcontracted services as well as planning and evaluation of vendors proposals.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, Project managers, Design, Engineering and Construction teams the Procurement Manager supports construction phase, business operations and projects by delivering efficient procurement solutions that balance quality, cost, risk, and operational requirements.

# **Specific Duties**

## Procurement Strategy & Planning

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business, and operational objectives.
    
* Establish procurement policies, procedures, and best practices to improve efficiency and governance.
    
* Plan procurement activities to ensure the timely availability of goods, materials, equipment, and services.
    
* Continuously review and improve procurement processes to increase efficiency and value.
    
* Responsible for managing the complete procurement life cycle across all disciplines, including all the phases outlined below.
    

## Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management

* Identify, evaluate, qualify, and develop local and international suppliers.
    
* Maintain an Approved Supplier List and supplier qualification process.
    
* Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key suppliers.
    
* Conduct supplier performance evaluations and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
    
* Perform market research, benchmarking, and commercial analysis to identify sourcing opportunities.
    

## Tendering & Contract Management

* Prepare, review, and manage RFQs, RFPs, tenders, commercial evaluations, and supplier selection processes.
    
* Collaborate closely with engineering to prepare and manage Bills of Quantities (BOQs), using tools such as Excel, Cype, Arquímedes, Presto, or similar measurement software.
    
* Draft & review tender documents, and construction contracts, ensuring alignment with project requirements
    
* Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, service levels, and contractual conditions.
    
* Draft, review, and administer procurement contracts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
    
* Ensure contracts effectively manage commercial and operational risks.
    

## Procurement Operations

* Coordinate with construction teams to ensure proper delivery, inspection, and acceptance of materials on site.
    
* Manage the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, including:
    
    * Purchase requisitions
        
    * Supplier selection
        
    * Purchase orders
        
    * Delivery coordination
        
    * Invoice reconciliation
        
    * Supplier performance monitoring
        
* Coordinate procurement activities across departments to ensure business continuity.
    
* Monitor supplier delivery performance and resolve procurement-related issues proactively.
    

## Cost Management

* Develop and manage procurement budgets, costs, cashflows, forecasting, change orders and deviations.
    
* Monitor procurement expenditures and identify opportunities for cost savings.
    
* Lead value engineering and cost optimization initiatives without compromising quality or operational requirements.
    
* Prepare procurement forecasts and support financial planning activities.
    

## Inventory & Supply Chain

* Monitor inventory levels and ensure appropriate stock levels are maintained.
    
* Coordinate supply planning with operational teams to prevent shortages and minimize excess inventory.
    
* Support supply chain continuity through effective planning and supplier collaboration.
    

## Risk & Compliance

* Identify, assess, and mitigate procurement risks, including:
    
    * Supply chain disruptions
        
    * Supplier dependency
        
    * Price volatility
        
    * Contractual risks
        
    * Regulatory compliance
        
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, internal controls, ethical standards, and applicable laws.
    
* Promote responsible and sustainable procurement practices where appropriate.
    

## Stakeholder Management

* Partner with Finance, Operations, Engineering, Production, Quality, Logistics, and other business functions to understand procurement requirements.
    
* Provide procurement expertise and commercial guidance to internal stakeholders.
    
* Foster collaborative relationships across the organization to support business objectives.
    

## Reporting & Performance Management

* Develop procurement KPIs and performance dashboards.
    
* Monitor supplier performance, procurement efficiency, savings, and service levels.
    
* Prepare regular management reports and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
    
* Utilize ERP systems and digital tools to enhance procurement visibility and reporting.
    
* Maintain accurate records of procurement activities, contracts, and suppliers, and provide regular reports to project management
    

# **Personal Requirements for the Role**

## Specific Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Procurement, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
    
* Professional procurement qualifications (CIPS or equivalent) are desirable.
    
* Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive procurement experience, including leadership responsibilities.
    
* Proven experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiation, and procurement operations.
    
* Proficiency in quantity take-off tools (Arquímedes, Presto, etc.)
    
* Experience implementing procurement systems, policies, and process improvements.
    
* Strong understanding of procurement best practices, commercial negotiations, and supply chain management.
    
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent).
    
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills; Power BI or other reporting tools are an advantage.
    
* Excellent written and spoken English
    
* Previous procurement experience in integrated construction projects is highly preferred. Experience in the poultry industry, including hatcheries, poultry farms, and related procurement, is also considered a key advantage and should be identified as a preferred qualification for this role.
    

# **Competencies, Skill & Attributes**

### ·***Strategic Thinking:*** Develops procurement strategies that align with organizational goals and deliver long-term value.

### ***·******Commercial Acumen:***  Strong negotiation, supplier management, and commercial decision-making capabilities.

### ·***Analytical Thinking:*** Uses data and market insights to support sourcing decisions and continuous improvement.

### ·***Financial Awareness***: Understands budgeting, cost analysis, forecasting, and value optimization.

### ·***Planning & Organization:*** Effectively manages multiple priorities in a dynamic business environment.

### ·***Communication & Influencing:*** Builds productive relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

### ·***Problem Solving:*** Identifies issues proactively and develops practical, commercially sound solutions.

### ·***Process Improvement:*** Continuously improves procurement processes through standardization, digitalization, and best practices.

### ·***Digital Literacy:*** Proficient in ERP systems, procurement platforms, Microsoft Office, and reporting tools.

This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog. You'll define where the product goes, make difficult prioritization decisions, and shape experiences that thousands of users rely on every day. You'll spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, and turn those insights into products that solve meaningful problems.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, questions assumptions, and is excited by building products where AI creates real customer value - not simply because it's the latest trend.

### What You'll Do

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Lucidya's Customer Service Suite, ensuring every investment moves the product closer to solving meaningful customer problems.
* Spend time with customer support teams, operations leaders, and enterprise customers to deeply understand how they work, where they struggle, and what would genuinely improve their day-to-day experience.
* Work closely with Engineering and Design to continuously deliver valuable improvements, favouring learning through iteration over waiting for perfection.
* Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical complexity, and long-term platform strategy.
* Champion AI-powered experiences that genuinely improve agent productivity and customer outcomes, rather than adding technology for technology's sake.
* Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure new capabilities are successfully adopted and create measurable business impact after launch.
* Use customer feedback, product analytics, market trends, and experimentation to continuously improve the product and validate product decisions.
* Create alignment across stakeholders by communicating product strategy, priorities, trade-offs, and roadmap decisions with clarity and confidence.
* Build trust across cross-functional teams by creating a collaborative environment where great ideas can come from anyone.

**Requirements**

### Who You Are

* You've spent **7-9 years building B2B SaaS products** and have owned a product or product suite end-to-end—not just individual features.
* You enjoy solving customer problems more than shipping features. You naturally ask *"What problem are we solving?"* before deciding *"What should we build?"*
* You're comfortable making difficult prioritization decisions and explaining the reasoning behind them, even when not everyone agrees.
* You enjoy spending time with customers and believe the best product decisions come from understanding real user behaviour rather than assumptions.
* You collaborate exceptionally well with engineers and designers. You don't need to write production code, but you're technical enough to challenge ideas, understand trade-offs, and make informed decisions together.
* You're naturally curious. Whether it's a new AI capability, workflow automation tool, or emerging technology, you've probably already experimented with it before someone asked you to.
* You value progress over perfection and know when it's time to ship, learn, and iterate.
* You're comfortable using data to support your decisions but know that numbers alone rarely tell the full story.
* You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences alike and can simplify complex ideas without oversimplifying the problem.

### You'll likely have experience with

* Product management platforms such as Jira and Confluence.
* Collaboration tools including Miro and Figma.
* Product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.
* SQL for exploring product data and validating hypotheses.
* Customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar.
* Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent productivity tools.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Previously worked in Customer Support, Customer Success, Contact Centres, or Service Operations before moving into Product.
* Built AI-powered workflows or automation products that delivered measurable customer outcomes.
* Experience designing or building enterprise customer service software.

### What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

Within your first six months, you'll have built a deep understanding of Lucidya's Customer Service Suite, our customers, and the workflows that power their support operations.

More importantly, you'll have:

* Become the go-to product leader for the Customer Service Suite, with a deep understanding of both the product and the customer problems it solves.
* Shipped meaningful improvements to OmniServ or the mobile experience that customers notice and that measurably improve how support teams work.
* Earned the trust of Engineering, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders by making thoughtful product decisions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and consistently delivering value.
* Built strong relationships with customers and established a regular feedback loop that directly influences product priorities.
* Defined and communicated a clear product roadmap that balances customer needs, business priorities, and long-term product strategy.
* Identified opportunities to leverage AI and automation in ways that create genuine value for support teams rather than simply introducing new technology.

### What the hiring process will look like

Our hiring process is designed to help both you and us determine whether this is the right fit.

The process typically includes:

* An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition.
* A Product Leadership interview to explore your product thinking, leadership style, and experience.
* A case study where you'll demonstrate how you approach solving complex product challenges and communicate your decisions.
* A presentation/panel interview to showcase your findings
* A final conversation with executive leadership / Offer discussion.

Throughout the process, we're looking beyond experience alone. We want to understand **how you think, how you make decisions, how you collaborate with others, and how you approach building products that customers genuinely love.**

Own webook’s data function end-to-end strategy, team, platform and delivery and be the single person accountable for data at webook. ## Company Description

A premier Saudi Arabian entertainment and hospitality company owned by the PIF. Was founded in 1997 as the nation’s first athlete representation agency,  has now evolved into a global developer of iconic destinations and spectacular live experiences.

## Job Description

The Maintenance Technician (Mechatronics) is responsible for the upkeep, troubleshooting, and repair of  
mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automated/control systems used across SELA's production  
workshop, event structures, kinetic sets, staging automation, and attraction-type installations. He/she works across preventive and reactive maintenance, ensuring machinery, tools, and automated equipment remain safe, reliable, and available for fabrication and live show operations. This is a hands-on technical role combining mechanical, electrical, and PLC/controls knowledge, suited to someone who can diagnose faults quickly and keep production and event equipment running with zero downtime during show-critical periods.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
1\. **Preventive & Reactive Maintenance**  
• Maintenance Planning: Develop and follow preventive maintenance schedules for workshop machinery  
(CNC routers, saws, welding equipment, compressors) and event/show equipment (motion bases, automation rigs, motorized scenic elements).  
• Inspection & Servicing: Perform routine inspection, lubrication, cleaning, calibration, and adjustment of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems to prevent breakdowns.  
• Fault Diagnosis & Repair: Diagnose and repair faults across mechanical assemblies, motors, gearboxes, sensors, actuators, and control systems, minimizing equipment downtime.  
• Emergency Response: Respond promptly to breakdown calls during fabrication, load-in, and live show windows, prioritizing show-critical and safety-critical equipment.  
  
2\. **Mechatronics & Controls**  
• Automation Systems: Install, test, and maintain automated and motion-control systems (PLC-driven show  
automation, motorized rigging, kinetic set pieces) used in event productions.  
• Electrical & Electronic Systems: Troubleshoot PLC I/O, sensors, VFDs (variable frequency drives), control panels, and low-voltage wiring associated with automated equipment.  
• Hydraulics & Pneumatics: Maintain and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems used in staging, lifts, and motion equipment, including hoses, cylinders, valves, and pumps.  
• Testing & Commissioning: Support testing and commissioning of new equipment, automated set pieces, and machinery before workshop or on-site deployment.  
  
3\. **Safety, Compliance & Documentation**  
• Safety Compliance: Follow lock-out/tag-out (LOTO), electrical safety, and machine guarding procedures at all times; ensure equipment meets relevant safety standards before use.  
• Risk Awareness: Identify and report unsafe equipment conditions and support Risk Assessments/Method  
Statements (RAMS) for automated or motorized installations.  
• Maintenance Records: Maintain accurate logs of maintenance activity, repairs, spare parts usage, and equipment performance history for each machine and automated system.  
• Spares & Inventory: Monitor spare parts stock for critical machinery and automation components, flagging reorder needs ahead of major productions.  
  
4\. **Team & Cross-functional Support**  
• Workshop Support: Work closely with the Installation Team Leader, Electrical Team Leader, and fabrication crew to keep tools and machinery production-ready.  
• Knowledge Sharing: Provide basic troubleshooting guidance and safe operating instruction to workshop and site staff using mechanized or automated equipment.

## Qualifications

**Qualifications & Skills**  
• Education: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Automation, or a related technical discipline.  
• Experience: 3+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in mechatronics, industrial automation, amusement/attraction ride maintenance, theatrical/show automation, or a similar workshop or production  
environment.  
• Technical Skills: Working knowledge of PLCs (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or equivalent), motor control systems, VFDs, hydraulics, pneumatics, and mechanical power transmission (gearboxes, belts, chains, bearings).  
• Diagnostic Tools: Proficiency using multimeters, diagnostic software, and hand/power tools for mechanical and electrical fault-finding.  
• Safety Certifications: Relevant electrical/mechanical H&S certifications (e.g., IOSH, NEBOSH, or equivalent local certification) preferred.  
• Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving under time pressure, methodical fault-finding approach, and ability to work independently during show-critical window

## Additional Information

**Typical Working Conditions**  
• Environment: Must be able to work in a workshop environment, which may include loud noise, dust, and heat, with some on-site installation work.  
• Hours: May require working evenings, weekends, and holidays to meet event deadlines.  
• Physical Requirements: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle tight deadlines and to work on site, which may include lifting, standing for long periods, and working in varied conditions.

## Job Description

The Electrical Team Leader for the fabrication and production workshop is responsible for the safe, code-compliant, and on-schedule delivery of all electrical works across SELA's event, exhibition, and show productions — from workshop pre-build through final on-site power-up and strike. He/she will coordinate with the Installation, Rigging, AV, and Design teams to ensure that power distribution, show lighting circuits, control cabling, and electrical fit-outs are built, tested, transported, and installed to the highest safety and quality standards, on time and within budget. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong technical proficiency in electrical systems for live events, combined with the ability to lead and develop a site-based electrical crew.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. **Production & Supervision**

* Workflow Management: Plan and schedule electrical works for each project, aligning with the overall production and installation timeline.
* Pre-fabrication & Testing: Ensure all power distribution boards, cable looms, control panels, and lighting/electrical assemblies are built, tested (PAT/continuity/load testing), and signed off in the workshop before dispatch to venue.
* Packing & Loading: Supervise the safe packing, labelling, and loading of cables, distros, fixtures, and electrical equipment to prevent damage or loss in transit.
* Resource Management: Monitor manpower, electrical materials, consumables, and tools, and requisition or secure them as required to avoid site delays.
* Quality Control: Inspect all electrical installations, temporary power distribution, and lighting/AV power circuits to ensure compliance with design specifications, SASO/Saudi Electrical Code requirements, and client quality standards.

2\. **Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Risk Management: Develop and enforce Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) for temporary power, generator hook-ups, and on-site electrical installations.
* Safety Enforcement: Ensure all team members comply with Health & Safety policies, including LOTO (lock-out/tag-out) procedures, RCD/earthing protection, safe use of PPE, and safe handling of power tools and test equipment.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all temporary electrical installations meet Saudi Electrical Code, civil defense, and venue-specific electrical safety requirements for public events.
* Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, organized, and safe workshop and site environment (5S standards), with cabling and distribution runs managed to eliminate trip and fire hazards.

3\. **Team Leadership & Communication**

* On-site Leadership: Lead daily site electrical operations and allocate tasks to electricians and technicians, ensuring efficient use of manpower to meet load-in and show-ready deadlines.
* Coaching & Mentoring: Train and mentor junior electricians and technicians on power distribution, cable management, lighting circuits, and tool/equipment safety.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct daily toolbox talks and team briefings, monitor crew performance, and provide feedback to improve efficiency and reduce rework or snags.
* Project Liaison: Liaise with production managers, lighting/AV designers, riggers, and site management to provide progress updates, resolve technical bottlenecks, and ensure a seamless power-up for every show or activation

## Qualifications

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in electrical works for live events, exhibitions, theatrical/scenic production, themed entertainment, or a similar fast-paced workshop and site environment.
* Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of temporary power distribution, generators, three-phase systems, show lighting circuits, cable management, and low-voltage control systems.
* Blueprint Interpretation: Ability to read and interpret electrical single-line diagrams, power plans, CAD drawings, and design specifications.
* Safety Certifications: Relevant electrical and H&S qualifications (e.g., licensed electrician certification, IOSH/NEBOSH, or equivalent local certification recognized in Saudi Arabia).
* Language & Mobility: Arabic and/or English proficiency preferred; willingness to travel to venues across the Kingdom and internationally as project needs require.
* Soft Skills: Strong leadership, ability to work under pressure against tight show deadlines, proactive problem-solving, and excellent communication with cross-functional production teams.  
    

## Additional Information

**Typical Working Conditions**  
• Environment: Must be able to work in a workshop environment, which may include loud noise, dust, and heat, with some on-site installation work.  
• Hours: May require working evenings, weekends, and holidays to meet event deadlines.  
• Physical Requirements: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle tight deadlines and to work on site, which may include lifting, standing for long periods, and working in varied conditions.

## Job Description

The Detailing Engineer sits within SELA's fabrication and production workshop, converting design concepts, 3D  
renders, and structural/architectural drawings into fully dimensioned, buildable shop drawings for event sets,  
exhibition stands, scenic elements, staging, and structures. He/she is the technical bridge between the Design  
department and the Workshop floor, ensuring every fabricated piece is engineered for accuracy, material efficiency, structural integrity, and safe rigging/installation before a single cut is made. This is a detail-critical, deadline-driven role requiring strong CAD/3D modeling skills combined with practical knowledge of fabrication methods used in live events.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
1\. **Detailing & Technical Drawing**  
• Shop Drawing Production: Convert approved concept designs, 3D renders, and architectural drawings into detailed 2D fabrication drawings and cutting lists for carpentry, metalwork, and scenic elements.  
• 3D Modeling: Build accurate 3D models (AutoCAD, SketchUp, Tekla, Solidworks, or equivalent) of sets, stands, and structures to validate dimensions, tolerances, and assembly sequence prior to production.  
• Material & BOQ Take-off: Generate precise bills of quantities and cut lists for timber, steel, aluminum, MDF, acrylic, and other fabrication materials to minimize wastage and support accurate procurement.  
• Structural Detailing: Detail load-bearing elements, connections, weld points, and fixings for platforms, trusses, staging, and rigging points, ensuring designs are structurally sound and code-compliant.  
• Clash Detection: Cross-check drawings against MEP, AV, lighting, and rigging layouts to identify and resolve clashes before fabrication begins.  
  
2\. **Production Support & Coordination**  
• Workshop Liaison: Work directly with the Installation Team Leader, carpenters, welders, and fabricators to clarify drawings, resolve on-the-shop-floor queries, and update details based on practical build constraints.  
• Design Liaison: Coordinate with Designers and Project Managers to confirm design intent, obtain approvals on technical revisions, and communicate any design changes required for buildability.  
• As-Built Updates: Revise and reissue drawings to reflect on-site or in-workshop modifications, maintaining an accurate as-built record for each project.  
• CNC & Machine Files: Prepare CNC cutting/routing files and machine-ready outputs where applicable, to streamline pre-fabrication in the workshop.  
  
3\. **Quality & Compliance**  
• Design Validation: Verify that all detailed drawings meet client specifications, structural safety margins, and applicable Saudi building and event safety codes.  
• Documentation Control: Maintain organized, version-controlled drawing registers and issue drawings through proper revision and approval workflows.  
• Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring detailing issues or fabrication inefficiencies and recommend standardized details, templates, or jigs to improve workshop throughput.

• Software Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp; working knowledge of Tekla Structures, Solidworks, Rhino, or 3ds Max is an advantage.  
• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of carpentry, metalwork, rigging, and structural connections, along with material properties and fabrication tolerances.

production deadlines, and clear communication with both design and shop-floor teams.

Join our professional maritime operations team as Chief Officer aboard our fleet of vessels. This leadership role is responsible for the safe and efficient management of deck operations, cargo and cargo safety, stability and ballasting, safety management system execution, crew supervision, and support to the Master in overall vessel operations. The Chief Officer will report to the Master, coordinate with technical and shore-based teams, and ensure compliance with international conventions and company policies.
Primary Responsibilities for Chief Officer - deck operations, cargo, safety

• The role of the Chief Officer is to manage the Deck Department and to assist the Master in the safe and efficient operation of the vessel.

• In the event of the Master becoming incapacitated, the Chief Officer shall assume the role of the Master.

• Should there is no standalone Safety Officer, the Chief Officer shall assume the role of shipboard Safety Officer.

• The responsibilities include, but are not limited to, deck department maintenance, stability and ballast operations, maintenance of all lifting appliances and the handling and stowage of dangerous cargo including the hazardous materials/ COSHH database and management system.

• Review with client representative new working locations, for gangway connections and lift plans according with IMCA guidelines.

• Ensure IMCA guidelines are followed for Dynamic Positioning Operation, where applicable.

• During anchor handling the Chief Officer is responsible for the planning and organization of the deck crew and of anchor handling equipment.

• Their responsibilities also include the planning of working hours for the deck crew and to monitor that rest hour requirements are complied with.

• Being responsible for the supervision, training, and evaluation of deck personnel. This includes maintaining and administering discipline to deck personnel.

• During their watch (Navigation/Deck), they are responsible for the safety and integrity of the vessel and that relevant procedure for the loading and unloading of attending vessels and helicopters are followed by the appointed personnel.

• They are to ensure that all work on deck is carried out in a safe and efficient manner. This includes responsibility for all entry work in accordance with the Permit to Work System.

• The responsibilities also include reporting as required by Integrated Management System.

• The Chief Officer acts as Stability Section Leader. Ballasting and de-ballasting to and from transit draught are normally carried out by Chief Officer.

• Being responsible for all aspects of the ship’s fire, safety, security and emergency equipment (LSA / FFA). This is to include regular maintenance and training of ship personnel in the use and deployment of all fire, safety, security and emergency equipment.

• Being responsible for refusing unsafe work and for carrying out all work in accordance with the established safety standards and work practices.

• Being responsible for the inventory, requisition, and upkeep of all deck stores according to the vessel’s budget.

• Through consultation with the Chief Engineer, ensuring that all enclosed / confined spaces, restricted areas (as per SSP), tank air vents and filling pipes throughout the vessel are clearly marked and identified.

• Responsible to the Master for the overall cleanliness and good condition of the vessel’s accommodation.

• Maintaining logbooks, sounding books, cargo space records, lifting equipment (including cargo gear) records, and towing equipment records accurately.

• Ensuring that the Garbage Management Plan is fully complied with, and the garbage record book is fully maintained complete with waste disposal receipts.

• Ensuring that all pollution prevention measures are in place and spill response equipment is maintained.

• Ensuring the proper training and conducting of drills and exercises are carried out and officially documented as per SOLAS, ISM Code and ISPS Code requirements and in reference to the Company’s Drill and Training Matrix.

• The sounding of tanks, cofferdams and bilges throughout the vessel at least once per day and the upkeep of the Sounding Records.

• Maintain and monitor the watertight/weathertight integrity of the vessel.

• If there are more than 2 qualified junior watch keeping officers on board, and the vessel is on sea voyages of 7 or more days, the Chief Officer is required to keep at least 1 navigational watch of 4 hours per week at Master’s discretion.

• The Chief Officer acts as second in command in all fire-fighting matters and may be required to act as Team Leader of an emergency team.

• During their watch, they are in charge of all Work carried out by the Deck department under the Permit to Work System and may be required to act as permit co-coordinator.

• The Chief Officer's duties in emergency situations are laid down in the vessel's Emergency Response Manual and/or stated on the Muster List.

• They are to carry out any lawful command as requested by Master.

• The Chief Officer shall co-operate closely with all other officers, with the Engineering Officers, The SDPO´s, the Charterer's Representative and the Camp Boss.

• The allocation of daily work to the deck crew

• Prepare appraisal reports for deck crew, trainee officers(Cadets)

• Advise Master on the performance of deck officers including appraisal reports.

• Responsible for training of deck cadets and is the shipboard training officer onboard (STO)

• Prepare requisitions for deck stores, spares ,paints and reconfirm requisitions as raised by other deck officers prior submission to the Master.

• Receiving and signing for deck stores, spares and paints and to ensure the quality and quantity of items delivered conform to the order.

• Wearing, inspecting and caring for required personal protective equipment.

• Any additional duties as assigned by the Master.

Required Qualifications - master certification, experience, medical fitness

• Certificate of Competency as per STCW reg II.

• STCW endorsements

• Valid Medical certificate

• DP Unlimited License (where applicable)

• DP experience as per IMCA M 117

• Ship Security Officer certificate as per STCW Regulation VI/5

• Minimum 12 months of experience in rank and similar type of vessel.

Preferred Skills - cargo specialization, leadership, technical aptitude

• Experience with offshore support vessels, AHTS, tanker, or energy-sector operations, including specialty cargo systems and dynamic cargo operations.

• Training in advanced cargo handling, stability management, tankerman procedures, and leadership or supervisory courses that enhance onboard team performance.

• Familiarity with electronic cargo planning tools, stability software, and bridge systems to support integrated operational decision-making.

• Demonstrated leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop and retain competent deck personnel and maintain safe, efficient operations.

Work Environment & Conditions - seafaring life, rotations, safety

• Seagoing leadership position with rotational deployments; assignments may include extended periods onboard with defined on/off rotation schedules.

• Work in offshore, port, and confined-space environments; ability to operate safely around moving machinery, at heights, and during adverse weather conditions when required.

• Must comply with medical fitness standards, vaccinations, and company pre-employment screening and certification verification processes.

Compensation & Benefits - competitive pay, seafarer benefits, development

• Competitive salary and marine benefits aligned with industry standards for Chief Officers in the energy and commercial vessel sectors.

• Comprehensive health coverage, life insurance, paid leave, retirement/savings plans, and repatriation benefits per company policy.

• Opportunities for professional development, leadership training, onboard instruction, and career progression to Master or shore-based management roles.

How to Apply - application process, documentation
Submit a detailed CV/resume highlighting relevant chief officer or senior deck officer sea service, certifications, endorsements, and recent sea service records. Include copies of key certifications, medical certificates, and contact information for professional references. Qualified applicants will be contacted for screening interviews, competency assessments, and practical evaluations.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Senior Traffic and Detour Engineer will serve as a senior technical specialist responsible for the planning, design, review, and implementation of traffic management and detour strategies for major road and infrastructure projects. The role ensures the safe and efficient movement of traffic during construction and operational phases while minimizing disruption to road users and maintaining network performance.

The role requires providing technical leadership in the development and evaluation of traffic management plans, detour schemes, and temporary traffic arrangements, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety requirements, and applicable standards.

## Your role

**Traffic Management and Detour Planning**

* Lead the development and review of Traffic Management Plans (TMPs), Detour Plans, and Temporary Traffic Control Plans for infrastructure and road projects.
* Design safe, efficient, and practical detour schemes to accommodate construction activities while maintaining traffic flow and minimizing congestion.
* Develop traffic staging and phasing plans aligned with construction sequencing and project delivery schedules.
* Ensure detour designs address safety, accessibility, emergency vehicle access, and operational continuity.

**Traffic Engineering Analysis**

* Conduct traffic impact assessments, traffic capacity analysis, and operational assessments to evaluate detour effectiveness.
* Analyze traffic volumes, turning movements, intersection performance, and road network operations.
* Utilize traffic modeling and simulation tools to assess and optimize traffic detour and management strategies.
* Review contractor-submitted traffic management and detour proposals and provide technical recommendations.

**Project Implementation and Site Coordination**

* Provide technical oversight during implementation of traffic detours and temporary traffic management measures.
* Conduct site inspections to ensure traffic diversions are implemented in accordance with approved plans and safety standards.
* Identify traffic risks, operational conflicts, and safety concerns, and implement mitigation measures.
* Support construction teams to ensure traffic management measures align with project schedules.

**Stakeholder Coordination and Approvals**

* Coordinate with clients, government authorities, traffic police, and contractors to obtain necessary approvals for detour and traffic management plans.
* Participate in technical coordination meetings and provide expert input on traffic-related matters.
* Support multidisciplinary coordination with design, construction, and supervision teams.

**Compliance and Quality Assurance**

* Ensure all traffic management and detour plans comply with national regulations, applicable standards, and project requirements.
* Ensure proper implementation of traffic safety measures, including signage, markings, barriers, and traffic control devices.
* Conduct technical reviews and audits to ensure quality and compliance.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Prepare and review traffic management reports, detour drawings, technical specifications, and method statements.
* Maintain documentation of approved traffic management plans and detour implementations.
* Provide technical reports, progress updates, and recommendations to project leadership.

* Experience coordinating with contractors, consultants, and government authorities.

* Strong expertise in traffic engineering, traffic management, and detour design.

Position Summary
Ladgov Corporation is seeking an experienced MSG Detachment Cook to provide daily meal preparation and food-service support at the Marine Security Guard Residence located at the U.S. Consulate General in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
The selected candidate will prepare and serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner for approximately eight Marine Security Guards, develop varied meal plans, maintain safe food-storage practices, and ensure the kitchen and dining areas remain clean, organized, and sanitary. The cook must be able to prepare high-quality American, international, regional, healthy, and dietary-sensitive meals while maintaining consistent food-safety and presentation standards.
Work Hours
Meal-service periods include:
• Breakfast: 7:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m.

• Lunch: 11:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m.

• Dinner: 5:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m.

The regular schedule is approximately eight hours per day, Sunday through Thursday , with daily work hours arranged around meal preparation, service, and cleanup requirements.
Essential Duties
• Prepare and serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner according to approved schedules.

• Develop and maintain a rotating 30-day menu with diverse meal selections.

• Prepare fresh American, international, local, and regional dishes.

• Provide healthy, vegetarian, and dietary-sensitive meal options.

• Coordinate menus, grocery requirements, food storage, and meal planning with the designated site representative.

• Maintain consistent recipes, portion sizes, food quality, appearance, and service temperatures.

• Inspect food items for quality, freshness, proper labeling, and expiration dates.

• Rotate food inventory using first-in, first-out procedures.

• Monitor refrigerators, freezers, dry-storage areas, and food temperatures.

• Prevent food spoilage, cross-contamination, waste, and unauthorized use of food supplies.

• Clean and sanitize the kitchen, dining areas, appliances, equipment, dishes, utensils, floors, counters, and food-contact surfaces after each meal.

• Maintain organized food-storage and inventory records.

• Track daily meal counts, food usage, menu acceptance, and food waste.

• Follow HACCP, SERV Safe, FDA Food Code, USDA, Codex Alimentarius, and applicable Saudi Arabian food-safety requirements.

• Use proper personal protective equipment and follow kitchen safety procedures.

• Immediately report equipment problems, food-safety concerns, illness, accidents, or supply shortages.

• Maintain professional conduct, appropriate attire, and respectful customer service.

• Protect keys, identification cards, equipment, supplies, and facility property.

• Support periodic kitchen, sanitation, inventory, and quality-control inspections.

Minimum Qualifications
• Minimum of three years of experience managing or performing food-service operations .

• Demonstrated experience preparing and presenting premium-quality meals.

• Experience developing menus and preparing meals for individuals with varied dietary, cultural, religious, and health requirements.

• Knowledge of food preparation, storage, sanitation, inventory control, and kitchen-cleaning procedures.

• Ability to prepare American and international cuisine.

• Ability to communicate effectively in English.

• Ability to work independently in a secure residential environment.

• Ability to pass required background and security screening.

• Physically capable of standing for extended periods, lifting kitchen supplies, and performing routine cleaning duties.

• Must be medically fit for duty and certified free of communicable diseases.

• Must possess or be able to obtain all food-handler permits, medical certifications, licenses, and approvals required in Saudi Arabia.

Preferred Qualifications
• ServSafe Food Handler or ServSafe Manager certification.

job_title: Manager of Customer / Patient Experience & Administration (Healthcare) - QHC000
description:
Job Title: Manager of Customer / Patient Experience & Administration

Department: Sport Medicine Center

Reports To: Senior Sport Medicine Manager

Role Summary

The Customer / Patient Experience & Administration Manager is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end patient journey and all front-of-house and administrative operations across the healthcare organization.   
The role ensures exceptional patient experience, efficient administrative processes, and seamless coordination between clinical and operational teams.

Reporting to the Senior Sport Medicine Manager, this position drives service excellence, operational efficiency, and patient-centered culture across registration, call centers, scheduling, billing support, and customer relations.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Customer / Patient Experience Strategy

* Design and implement a customer /patient experience strategy aligned with organizational values and quality standards.

* Map and optimize the end-to-end customer / patient journey (access, appointment, arrival, clinical screening, treatment, discharge, and follow-up, and digital engagement).

* Lead customer /patient satisfaction improvement programs.

* Oversee customer/patient feedback systems, surveys, complaints, and resolution processes.

2\. Administrative Operations

* Oversee all administrative and front-desk functions including registration, scheduling, medical records, call center, and patient coordination.

* Ensure efficient services flow, accurate data capture, and timely documentation.

* Standardize SOPs for admissions, discharge, referrals, and insurance coordination.

* Monitor capacity, waiting times, and service level performance.

3\. Integration with Clinical, Rehab & Performance

* Work closely with all the departments and functions to ensure experience is embedded in care delivery.

* Ensure consistent experience standards across physicians, therapists, coaches, nurses, and front-line teams.

* Lead interdisciplinary experience governance forums.

4\. Customer /Patient Engagement & Communication

* Lead individual and patient liaison services and manage escalations and complex cases.

* Ensure clear, compassionate communication with individuals, patients and families.

* Coordinate multilingual services and accessibility support where required.

* Develop customer /patient engagement, retention, and loyalty programs.

* Lead communication, education, and experience personalization strategies.

* Oversee customer /patient communities, athlete support programs, and long-term care relationships.

4\. Quality, Compliance & Governance

* Ensure administrative processes comply with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards (CBAHI, JCI), and data privacy requirements.

* Implement quality assurance audits for patient experience and administrative services.

* Collaborate with GRC and Clinical Quality teams on patient rights and safety standards.

5\. Digital Customer /Patient Experience

* Oversee digital touchpoints including appointment systems, customer portals, mobile apps, and CRM platforms.

* Drive automation and paperless workflows to improve access, efficiency, and satisfaction.

6\. Performance Management & Reporting

* Define KPIs for customer /patient experience and administration (waiting time, complaints, first-call resolution, no-show rate).

* Develop dashboards and reports for the senior sport medicine director and  executive leadership.

* Use data to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

7\. Team Leadership & Development

* Lead and develop teams across reception, call center, patient relations, and administrative services.

* Ensure training in service excellence, communication, privacy, and healthcare regulations.

* Build a culture of empathy, professionalism, and accountability.

8\. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Medical, Nursing, Finance (RCM), IT, and Marketing teams to ensure a seamless patient journey.

* Support service line expansion, new clinic openings, and operational readiness from a patient experience perspective.

* Build a patient-centric culture across the organization.

* Design and oversee service excellence training for all staff (clinical and non-clinical).

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related field.

* Master’s degree preferred (MHA, MBA, Service Design, Healthcare Quality).

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare operations, patient experience, or service excellence roles.

* Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and patient rights.

* Proven leadership in customer experience, administration, and service operations.

Core Competencies

* Patient-Centered Service Design

* Healthcare Administration & Operations

* Customer Experience (CX) Leadership

* Process Optimization & Digital Enablement

* Communication & Conflict Resolution

* Performance Management & Analytics

* Team Leadership & Culture Building

* Regulatory & Accreditation Compliance

description:
**من نحن**

نحن الشريك الرائد في قطاع السلع الكمالية في الشرق الأوسط، إذ نمتلك أكثر من 600 متجرًا بالإضافة إلى 300 علامةً تجارية، ولدينا خبرة تتجاوز 65 عامًا في المنطقة - ممّا جعلنا طرفًا رئيسيًا في قطاعات الجمال والموضة والهدايا من خلال تقديمنا لخدماتٍ مميّزة لشركائنا وتَمَكننا من ابهاج جميع عملائنا. إنّنا نتحوّل بسرعة من مؤسسة توزيع وتجارة تقليدية تبيع السلع الكمالية بالتجزئة في الشرق الأوسط إلى مؤسسة تجارية هجينة للبيع بالتجزئة تجعل تجربة المنتجات الفاخرة في متناول عملائنا في كلّ مكان.

ولدعم المرحلة القادمة من نموّنا، فإنّنا نهدف إلى بناء فريقٍ عمل ذات مواصفاتٍ عالمية، وإلى توظيف التكنولوجيا والبيانات في التطوير المستمر لكلّ جانبٍ من عملياتنا، ابتداءً من التجزئة التقليدية حتّى سلسلة الإمداد وولاء العملاء. ولهذا، فإنّنا نبحث عن أصحاب أفضل المواهب والقدرات للانضمام إلينا في رحلتنا لاستكشاف آفاقٍ جديدةٍ معًا.

**مهامك الوظيفية**

في شلهوب نحن نُعبّر عن كل ما هو استثنائي ومتفرّد. وستكون مسؤولًا خلال عملك كمستشار للموضة عن تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الفردية والإجمالية مع تقديمك تجربة استثنائية للضيوف وحرصك على تقديم الدعم في إدارة علاقات العملاء وتجارب العملاء وغيرها من المبادرات الرئيسية المتعلّقة بالعملاء والموظفين في المتجر. ومن خلال وظيفتك نتوقع منك أداء المهام التالية:

·   العمل على جمع البيانات حول سلوك العملاء وأكثر المنتجات مبيعًا وأقلها مبيعًا، وهو ما سيُشكّل مكوّنًا رئيسيًا في مراجعات سير أمور العمل.

·   تعزيز العلاقات مع العملاء من خلال نهج شامل ومتعدّد القنوات.

·   تقديم ملاحظات ومعلومات بخصوص المنتج للعميل قبل عملية الشراء.

·   تعزيز مؤشر قياس ولاء الموظفين من خلال مبادرات وثقافة وخبرات الموظفين.

·   التأكّد من الالتزام بإرشادات التجارة المرئية وإجراءات التشغيل القياسية.

·   التأكّد من إجراء عملية الشراء الإلكتروني ثم الاستلام من المتجر طبقًا لاتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة.

·   التأكّد من الحصول على بيانات العملاء طبقًا لمتطلبات فريق التسويق.

·   الترويج لبرنامج ولاء العملاء (MUSE) والبقاء على اطلاع على عروض التطبيقات الإلكترونية وما إلى ذلك.

·      مواكبة جميع أنشطة وحملات وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي الخاصة بعلامتنا التجارية.

·      تعزيز المبيعات داخل المتجر.

·      دعم مبادرات تجربة العملاء في المتجر.

·      إيصال الملاحظات بخصوص الأمور الناجعة وغير الناجعة داخل المتجر.

**مقوّمات نجاحك**

**·**      يُفضّل وجود خبرة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء مع علامات تجارية مختصة ببيع السلع الكمالية بالتجزئة.

ستُحوّل طموحاتك معنا إلى حقيقة. وسنُساعدك على تصميم رحلتك العملية من خلال التجارب الغنيّة وفرص التعلّم والتطوّر والتعامل مع المهام المختلفة في إطار دورك أو من خلال تنقلك الداخلي. حيث توفِّر مجموعتنا كلّ يوم مساراتٍ مهنية متنوعة للأشخاص الاستثنائيين.

***دعوة لجميع المرشحين للتّقديم!***
